Protests peaked in February and March 2025, but they began to fade since then. The song "Bayar, Bayar, Bayar" from punk music duo [[Sukatani]], used as a theme song for the protest, to criticise the Police's performance which is considered unprofessional and full of [[bribery]], [[extortion]], and [[gratification]] which happened inside the Police administration in Indonesia.{{Cite web |date=21 February 2025 |title=Sukatani: Mengapa lagu band punk Sukatani 'Bayar Bayar Bayar' jadi lagu tema aksi 'Indonesia Gelap'? |trans-title=Sukatani: Why did the punk song 'Bayar Bayar Bayar' become the theme song of 'Indonesia Gelap' protests? |url=https://www.bbc.com/indonesia/articles/cwyevz4yyn1o |access-date=4 March 2025 |website=BBC News Indonesia |language=id}} === Second phase: ''#TolakRUUTNI'' protests === A second wave of demonstrations against the Draft Law on the Indonesian National Army (RUU TNI) took place across multiple regions, including Yogyakarta and Jakarta, on 19–20 March 2025. The protests involved students, lecturers, and civil society organizations, who expressed concerns that the bill could undermine democratic principles and civilian supremacy over the military. In Yogyakarta, protesters from the [[University of Gadjah Mada]] (UGM) and the [[Islamic University of Indonesia]] (UII) presented several key demands:{{Cite web |last=Prodjo |first=Wahyu Adityo |date=19 March 2025 |title=Ratusan Mahasiswa dan Dosen Gelar Demo Tolak RUU TNI, Sampaikan 5 Tuntutan |url=https://www.kompas.com/edu/read/2025/03/19/200858971/ratusan-mahasiswa-dan-dosen-gelar-demo-tolak-ruu-tni-sampaikan-5-tuntutan |access-date=20 March 2025 |website=kompas.com |language=id |archive-date=19 March 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250319143629/https://www.kompas.com/edu/read/2025/03/19/200858971/ratusan-mahasiswa-dan-dosen-gelar-demo-tolak-ruu-tni-sampaikan-5-tuntutan |url-status=live }}{{Cite web |author=Gusti Grehenson |date=19 March 2025 |title=Dosen dan Mahasiswa UGM Gelar Aksi Tolak RUU TNI |url=https://ugm.ac.id/id/berita/dosen-dan-mahasiswa-ugm-gelar-aksi-tolak-ruu-tni/ |access-date=20 March 2025 |website=Universitas Gadjah Mada |language=id-ID |archive-date=7 April 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250407181252/https://ugm.ac.id/id/berita/dosen-dan-mahasiswa-ugm-gelar-aksi-tolak-ruu-tni/ |url-status=live }} # Demand that the Government and DPR cancel the revision of the TNI Law, which lacks transparency, is rushed, and disregards public opinion, as it constitutes a constitutional violation. # Demand that the Government and DPR uphold the constitution and remain committed to the Reform Agenda by preserving the principles of civilian supremacy and equality before the law, while firmly rejecting the dual function of the TNI/Polri (''[[dwifungsi]]''). # Demand that the TNI/Polri, as state institutions, undergo internal reforms and enhance their professionalism to restore public trust. # Urge all academics across Indonesia to take a firm stance against actions that undermine democracy, violate the constitution, and deviate from the reform agenda. # Encourage and support civil society efforts to safeguard the Reform Agenda by actively monitoring and holding the Government and Parliament accountable. On 19 March 2025, students from [[Trisakti University]] staged a demonstration at Gerbang Pancasila, within the Parliament Complex in Jakarta, opposing the proposed revision of the Indonesian National Army Law (UU TNI). They presented four main demands, expressing concerns that the revisions could weaken civilian supremacy and potentially reintroduce the military's dual function (''dwifungsi'' TNI) in politics and governance.{{Cite AV media |url=https://www.metrotvnews.com/play/b3JCp2aW-menkum-dicegat-mahasiswa-tolak-revisi-uu-tni |title=Menkum Dicegat Mahasiswa, Tolak Revisi UU TNI |language=id |access-date=20 March 2025 |work=Metro TV |archive-date=26 March 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250326150053/https://www.metrotvnews.com/play/b3JCp2aW-menkum-dicegat-mahasiswa-tolak-revisi-uu-tni |url-status=live }} The demands were presented to Minister of Law, [[Supratman Andi Agtas]]. The key demands of the protest included:{{Cite web |author=Hidayat Salam |date=19 March 2025 |title=Menteri Hukum Dipaksa Temui Demonstran yang Menolak RUU TNI |url=https://www.kompas.id/artikel/menteri-hukum-dipaksa-temui-demonstran-yang-menolak-ruu-tni |access-date=20 March 2025 |website=Kompas|language=id}}{{Cite web |last=Cahyono |first=Tri Wahyu |title=Gelar Demonstrasi di Gerbang Pancasila DPR Tolak Revisi UU TNI, Berikut Isi Pernyataan Sikap Aktivis Universitas Trisakti |work=Radar Solo |url=https://radarsolo.jawapos.com/nasional/845784134/gelar-demonstrasi-di-gerbang-pancasila-dpr-tolak-revisi-uu-tni-berikut-isi-pernyataan-sikap-aktivis-universitas-trisakti |access-date=20 March 2025 |language=id |archive-date=19 March 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250319060218/https://radarsolo.jawapos.com/nasional/845784134/gelar-demonstrasi-di-gerbang-pancasila-dpr-tolak-revisi-uu-tni-berikut-isi-pernyataan-sikap-aktivis-universitas-trisakti |url-status=live }} # Reject the entire draft revision of the TNI Law which is considered to weaken civilian supremacy and open up opportunities for the return of the dual function of the TNI. # Urging the removal and termination of active TNI-Polri officers from civilian positions to prevent abuse of power and corrupt practices in the military. # Achieve civilian supremacy and stop the neglect of the reform agenda to ensure that the military remains in the corridor of its main task as the guardian of national defence. # Reject all forms of [[Militarization|militarisation]] in civilian government and demand the government's commitment to safeguard democratic values and human rights. = top | label = [[Wamena]]}} }} === Sumatra === In [[Banda Aceh]], students from [[Syiah Kuala University]] (USK) organised a protest in front of the Aceh Regional House of Representatives (DPRA). They additionally demanded transparency of the use of a special autonomy fund. The head of [[NasDem Party]]'s fraction and member of the DPRA third commission, Nurchalis, promised that the students' demands would be discussed at the legislature and carried to the national level.{{cite web|url=https://www.rmolaceh.id/aksi-indonesia-gelap-mahasiswa-aceh-tolak-efesiensi-anggaran-dan-mbg|title=Aksi Indonesia Gelap, Mahasiswa Aceh Tolak Efesiensi Anggaran dan MBG|website=rmolaceh.id|access-date=19 February 2025|author1=Rmolnetwork|date=19 February 2025|archive-date=20 February 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250220154039/https://www.rmolaceh.id/aksi-indonesia-gelap-mahasiswa-aceh-tolak-efesiensi-anggaran-dan-mbg|url-status=dead}} The protesters left significant rubbish, ranging from used drinking bottles to banners. Since the protesters ignored the requests by journalists to clean the rubbish, it was cleaned by the police.{{cite web|url=https://www.rmolaceh.id/sampah-berserakan-di-halaman-dpr-aceh-usai-aksi-demo-indonesia-gelap|title=Sampah Berserakan di DPR Aceh Usai Aksi Demo Indonesia Gelap|website=rmolaceh.id|access-date=19 February 2025|author1=Rmolnetwork|date=19 February 2025|archive-date=20 February 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250220154028/https://www.rmolaceh.id/sampah-berserakan-di-halaman-dpr-aceh-usai-aksi-demo-indonesia-gelap|url-status=dead}} [[File:Unjuk rasa mahasiswa di Medan 2025.jpg|thumb|Student protestors from the [[State Islamic University of North Sumatera|State Islamic University of North Sumatra]] converse with Palacheta Subies Subianto, a representative from North Sumatra DPRD who is also a member of the [[Golkar]] party in front of the building.{{Cite web |title=DPRD-Sumut |url=https://dprd.sumutprov.go.id/blog/berita-terkini/451 |access-date=2025-04-22 |website=dprd.sumutprov.go.id |archive-date=2 April 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250402011511/https://dprd.sumutprov.go.id/blog/berita-terkini/451 |url-status=live }}]] In [[Medan]], students from the [[State Islamic University of North Sumatra]] protested front of the building of the North Sumatra Regional House of Representatives (DPRD) on 20 February. They carried several banners, and the building was guarded by dozens of personnel. After hours, DPRD representatives met them and guaranteed that their demands will be brought to the DPRD and national DPR.{{cite web |last1=Media |first1=Kompas Cyber |url=https://medan.kompas.com/read/2025/02/20/164405778/diguyur-hujan-mahasiswa-demo-indonesia-gelap-tetap-bertahan-di-dprd-sumut |title=Diguyur Hujan, Mahasiswa Demo "Indonesia Gelap" Tetap Bertahan di DPRD Sumut |website=medan.kompas.com |access-date=20 February 2025 |date=20 February 2025 |archive-date=4 April 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250404051203/https://medan.kompas.com/read/2025/02/20/164405778/diguyur-hujan-mahasiswa-demo-indonesia-gelap-tetap-bertahan-di-dprd-sumut |url-status=live }} Protests resumed next day, not long after, a representative of Commission C of the legislature, Palacheta Subies Subianto met them. Several posters were attached to the fences of the DPRD,{{cite web|url=https://www.detik.com/sumut/berita/d-7789313/didemo-mahasiswa-poster-indonesia-gelap-mejeng-di-pagar-dprd-sumut|title=Didemo Mahasiswa, Poster 'Indonesia Gelap' Mejeng di Pagar DPRD Sumut|website=detik.com|access-date=21 February 2025|archive-date=23 February 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250223082950/https://www.detik.com/sumut/berita/d-7789313/didemo-mahasiswa-poster-indonesia-gelap-mejeng-di-pagar-dprd-sumut|url-status=live}} and used tires were burned during the event.{{cite web |url=https://sumut.inews.id/berita/demo-indonesia-gelap-di-depan-dprd-sumut-memanas-mahasiswa-bakar-ban |title=Demo Indonesia Gelap di Depan DPRD Sumut Memanas, Mahasiswa Bakar Ban |website=sumut.inews.id |access-date=21 February 2025 |last1=Siregar |first1=Wahyudi Aulia |date=21 February 2025 |archive-date=23 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250223082951/https://sumut.inews.id/berita/demo-indonesia-gelap-di-depan-dprd-sumut-memanas-mahasiswa-bakar-ban |url-status=live }} On 26 March, students from the North Sumatra Students' Union Alliance began to organise a sit-in front of the DPRD building at 15:00 [[Time in Indonesia|WIB]], while some others were inside the building's hall after successfully jumping over its fence. The protests escalated after they burned used tires and clashed with policemen.{{cite web|url=https://www.detik.com/sumut/berita/d-7843171/puluhan-mahasiswa-demo-di-dprd-sumut-tuntut-pencabutan-uu-tni|title=Puluhan Mahasiswa Demo di DPRD Sumut Tuntut Pencabutan UU TNI|website=detik.com|access-date=26 March 2025}} Next day, Accumulation of People's and Labour's Anger (AKBAR) held a protest in the same building, but later clashed with the police. According to the [[Commission for Missing Persons and Victims of Violence]] (KontraS), dozens of people were injured during the event.{{cite web|url=https://www.cnnindonesia.com/nasional/20250327163816-20-1213794/demo-tolak-uu-tni-di-medan-ricuh-massa-aksi-diduga-dipukuli-aparat|title=Demo Tolak UU TNI di Medan Ricuh, Massa Aksi Diduga Dipukuli Aparat|website=cnnindonesia.com|access-date=27 March 2025}} In [[Pematangsiantar]], on 27 March, students from the [[University of Simalungun]] clashed with policemen at Pematangsiantar DPRD, after attempting to forcefully enter the building. Three protesters were arrested by the police,{{cite web|url=https://www.kompas.tv/nasional/583551/demo-tolak-uu-tni-mahasiswa-coba-terobos-gedung-dprd-pematang-siantar|title=Demo Tolak UU TNI, Mahasiswa Coba Terobos Gedung DPRD Pematang Siantar|website=kompas.tv|access-date=2025-03-31|archive-date=27 March 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250327181818/https://www.kompas.tv/nasional/583551/demo-tolak-uu-tni-mahasiswa-coba-terobos-gedung-dprd-pematang-siantar|url-status=live}} meanwhile, one of the students, Afriadi Lesmana, was beaten up by a DPRD member and municipal policemen.{{cite web|url=https://www.detik.com/sumut/hukum-dan-kriminal/d-7848566/ulah-anggota-dprd-pematangsiantar-diduga-puluk-mahasiswa-yang-demo-uu-tni|title=Ulah Anggota DPRD Pematangsiantar Diduga Puluk Mahasiswa yang Demo UU TNI|website=detik.com|access-date=2025-03-31}} In [[Padang]], students from [[Andalas University]] (UNAND) and [[Padang State Polytechnics]] (PNP) protested front of the UNAND entrance gate.{{cite web|url=https://www.tempo.co/politik/sederet-keresahan-mahasiswa-unand-dan-pnp-diungkapkan-dalam-aksi-indonesia-gelap-1208672|title=Sederet Keresahan Mahasiswa Unand dan PNP Diungkapkan dalam Aksi Indonesia Gelap|website=tempo.co|access-date=18 February 2025|archive-date=18 March 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250318115653/https://www.tempo.co/politik/sederet-keresahan-mahasiswa-unand-dan-pnp-diungkapkan-dalam-aksi-indonesia-gelap-1208672|url-status=live}} Later, hundreds of students under the All-West Sumatra Alliance of Students' Unions protested in front of the building of the West Sumatra DPRD on 18 February 2025 at 15:00 WIB, and also held several banners.{{cite web|url=https://www.ayoindonesia.com/nasional/0114576485/berlanjut-ini-daftar-aksi-indonesia-gelap-di-berbagai-daerah-hari-ini-18-februari-2025-semarang-malang-sumbar|title=Berlanjut! Ini Daftar Aksi Indonesia Gelap di Berbagai Daerah Hari Ini 18 Februari 2025: Semarang, Malang, Sumbar|website=ayoindonesia.com|access-date=18 February 2025|archive-date=18 March 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250318032907/https://www.ayoindonesia.com/nasional/0114576485/berlanjut-ini-daftar-aksi-indonesia-gelap-di-berbagai-daerah-hari-ini-18-februari-2025-semarang-malang-sumbar|url-status=live}}{{cite web|url=https://www.liputan6.com/regional/read/5926319/aksi-unjuk-rasa-indonesia-gelap-di-sumbar-mahasiswa-orasi-di-depan-gedung-dprd?page=2|title=Aksi Unjuk Rasa 'Indonesia Gelap' di Sumbar, Mahasiswa Orasi di Depan Gedung DPRD|website=liputan6.com|date=18 February 2025|access-date=18 February 2025|archive-date=19 February 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250219010044/https://www.liputan6.com/regional/read/5926319/aksi-unjuk-rasa-indonesia-gelap-di-sumbar-mahasiswa-orasi-di-depan-gedung-dprd?page=2|url-status=live}} In [[Bukittinggi]], a number of community elements and the Bukittinggi student alliances, including the [[Indonesian Muslim Student Union]] (SEMMI) of Bukittinggi City, held a demonstration at the Bukittinggi DPRD building on 20 March 2025.{{Cite web |title=Aksi Demonstrasi di DPRD Bukittinggi: Kenapa Rapat RUU TNI Dilakukan Tertutup Di Hotel? |url=https://sumbartime.com/aksi-demonstrasi-di-dprd-bukittinggi-kenapa-rapat-ruu-tni-dilakukan-tertutup-di-hotel/ |access-date=23 March 2025 |website=Sumbartime.com |language=id |archive-date=13 May 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250513162517/https://sumbartime.com/aksi-demonstrasi-di-dprd-bukittinggi-kenapa-rapat-ruu-tni-dilakukan-tertutup-di-hotel/ |url-status=live }}{{Cite web |date=20 March 2025 |title=Tolak RUU TNI, Aliansi Mahasiswa Gelar Demo ke DPRD Bukittinggi |url=https://bacalahnews.com/tolak-ruu-tni-aliansi-mahasiswa-gelar-demo-ke-dprd-bukittinggi/ |access-date=23 March 2025 |website=Bacalah News |language=en-US |archive-date=21 April 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250421054559/https://bacalahnews.com/tolak-ruu-tni-aliansi-mahasiswa-gelar-demo-ke-dprd-bukittinggi/ |url-status=live }} In [[Pekanbaru]], students from the Islamic University of Riau protested front of the Riau DPRD building on 26 February. They additionally demanded for the reimbursement of scholarships for 6,000 students. The protesters dispersed after submitting their demands to the parliament members.{{cite web|url=https://m.halloriau.com/read-14605016-2025-02-26-indonesia-gelap-di-dprd-massa-aksi-desak-pencairan-beasiswa-6000-mahasiswa-riau-dan-sahkan-uu-perampasan-aset.html|title=Indonesia Gelap di DPRD, Massa Aksi Desak Pencairan Beasiswa 6.000 Mahasiswa Riau dan Sahkan UU Perampasan Aset|website=Hallo Riau|access-date=27 February 2025|archive-date=16 April 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250416120448/https://m.halloriau.com/read-14605016-2025-02-26-indonesia-gelap-di-dprd-massa-aksi-desak-pencairan-beasiswa-6000-mahasiswa-riau-dan-sahkan-uu-perampasan-aset.html|url-status=live}} On 14 August, protesters from University of Riau broke down the gate of governor office at Cut Nyak Dien Road, in an attempt to meet Abdul Wahid, the governor of Riau. They demanded him to answer local issues, such as wildfires, ambiguities on scholarships, and infrastructural issues.{{cite web|url=https://m.goriau.com/berita/baca/demo-mahasiswa-unri-geruduk-kantor-gubernur-riau-hingga-jebol-pagar.html|title=Demo, Mahasiswa Unri Geruduk Kantor Gubernur Riau Hingga Jebol Pagar|website=Go Riau|date=14 August 2025 |access-date=2025-08-16}} In [[Tanjungpinang]], 62 students protested front of the Riau Islands DPRD building. They were guarded by 150 joint personnel from regional and municipal police.{{cite web|url=https://www.hariankepri.com/150-aparat-amankan-demo-kapolresta-apresiasi-aksi-mahasiswa-yang-tertib/|title=150 Aparat Amankan Demo, Kapolresta Apresiasi Aksi Mahasiswa yang Tertib|website=Harian Kepri|date=20 February 2025|access-date=20 February 2025|archive-date=20 March 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250320024145/https://www.hariankepri.com/150-aparat-amankan-demo-kapolresta-apresiasi-aksi-mahasiswa-yang-tertib/|url-status=live}} In [[Palembang]], on 20 February, hundreds of students, mainly from [[Raden Fatah State Islamic University]] (UIN Raden Fatah), walked from Campus A at 10:00 WIB and arrived in front of the building of South Sumatra DPRD at 10:30 WIB.{{cite web|url=https://www.tempo.co/politik/ratusan-mahasiswa-demo-indonesia-gelap-di-depan-kantor-drpd-sumsel--1209652|title=Ratusan Mahasiswa Demo Indonesia Gelap di Depan Kantor DRPD Sumsel|website=tempo.co|access-date=20 February 2025|archive-date=23 February 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250223082950/https://www.tempo.co/politik/ratusan-mahasiswa-demo-indonesia-gelap-di-depan-kantor-drpd-sumsel--1209652|url-status=live}} They attempted to bring used tires top of a command car, but they were obstructed by forces. After negotiations, they were allowed to do so. However, after failing to meet the speaker of South Sumatra DPRD, Andi Dinialdie, protesters brought down the tires and burned them in front of the building.{{cite web |last1=Media |first1=Kompas Cyber |url=https://regional.kompas.com/read/2025/02/20/132528478/demo-indonesia-gelap-di-palembang-mahasiswa-bakar-ban-karena-tak-diterima |title=Demo Indonesia Gelap di Palembang, Mahasiswa Bakar Ban Karena Tak Diterima Ketua DPRD Sumsel |website=Kompas |access-date=20 February 2025 |date=20 February 2025 |archive-date=23 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250223082950/https://regional.kompas.com/read/2025/02/20/132528478/demo-indonesia-gelap-di-palembang-mahasiswa-bakar-ban-karena-tak-diterima |url-status=live }} It was previously projected that it would be attended by 1,000 people.{{cite web|url=https://palembang.tribunnews.com/2025/02/18/kritisi-kebijakan-prabowo-seribu-mahasiswa-di-palembang-akan-gelar-demo-indonesia-gelap-20-februari|title=Kritisi Kebijakan Prabowo, Seribu Mahasiswa di Palembang Akan Gelar Demo Indonesia Gelap 20 Februari|website=Tribun News|access-date=18 February 2025|archive-date=16 April 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250416120425/https://palembang.tribunnews.com/2025/02/18/kritisi-kebijakan-prabowo-seribu-mahasiswa-di-palembang-akan-gelar-demo-indonesia-gelap-20-februari|url-status=live}} The protesters also gave an ultimatum of 3 × 24 hours to the government to take position regarding the budget cuts. Then, deputy speaker Ilyas Panji and member of parliament M Nasir met the protesters and agreed to reject budget cuts and to fulfill their demands.{{cite web|url=https://regional.kompas.com/read/2025/02/20/141130878/demo-indonesia-gelap-di-palembang-dprd-sumsel-diberi-waktu-3x24-jam-untuk|title=Demo "Indonesia Gelap" di Palembang, DPRD Sumsel Diberi Waktu 3X24 Jam untuk Ambil Sikap|website=Kompas|access-date=18 February 2025|archive-date=23 February 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250223082950/https://regional.kompas.com/read/2025/02/20/141130878/demo-indonesia-gelap-di-palembang-dprd-sumsel-diberi-waktu-3x24-jam-untuk|url-status=live}} In [[Pangkalpinang]], students from [[University of Bangka Belitung]] together with Bangka Belitung Students' Union Alliance, protested front of the building of the Bangka Belitung DPRD. They arrived at 15:20 WIB.{{cite web|url=https://belitung.tribunnews.com/2025/02/19/ratusan-mahasiswa-ubb-demo-di-dprd-babel-suarakan-kondisi-indonesia-gelap-akibat-kebijakan-prabowo|title=Ratusan Mahasiswa UBB Demo di DPRD Babel Suarakan Kondisi Indonesia Gelap Akibat Kebijakan Prabowo|website=belitung.tribunnews.com|access-date=19 February 2025|archive-date=16 April 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250416120426/https://belitung.tribunnews.com/2025/02/19/ratusan-mahasiswa-ubb-demo-di-dprd-babel-suarakan-kondisi-indonesia-gelap-akibat-kebijakan-prabowo|url-status=live}} In [[Bandar Lampung]], hundreds of students from various local universities protested in front of the Lampung provincial government complex. They carried an oratory car as well as several banners, one of them has the inscription {{lang|id|PENDIDIKAN JADI TARUHAN, INDONESIA CEMAS, DARURAT PENDIDIKAN, ALERTA ALERTA!}} (Education is at stake, Indonesia is anxious, education emergency, alert alert!).{{cite web|url=https://lampung.idntimes.com/news/lampung/tama-wiguna/soroti-efisiensi-anggaran-ratusan-mahasiswa-demo-di-pemprov-lampung?page=all&_gl=1*s5b1n0*_ga*a2JNTTFsdTUzNExlVVlqdFRJTnR2cUZJbG1QblpnVDhUcUh3X21jUGVMZ1I1cFpxVHNjeVRBdnVjMF93X0VMQg..*_ga_TT180KERFB*MTczOTgwNDU1Ny4xLjAuMTczOTgwNDU1Ny4wLjAuMA..|title=Soroti Efisiensi Anggaran, Ratusan Mahasiswa Demo di Pemprov Lampung|website=IDN Times|date=17 February 2025|access-date=17 February 2025|archive-date=4 April 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250404051216/https://lampung.idntimes.com/news/lampung/tama-wiguna/soroti-efisiensi-anggaran-ratusan-mahasiswa-demo-di-pemprov-lampung?page=all&_gl=1%2As5b1n0%2A_ga%2Aa2JNTTFsdTUzNExlVVlqdFRJTnR2cUZJbG1QblpnVDhUcUh3X21jUGVMZ1I1cFpxVHNjeVRBdnVjMF93X0VMQg..%2A_ga_TT180KERFB%2AMTczOTgwNDU1Ny4xLjAuMTczOTgwNDU1Ny4wLjAuMA..|url-status=live}} In [[Bengkulu (city)|Bengkulu]], students mainly from Muhammadiyah Bengkulu University gathered in Simpang Lima, Ratu Sambang District. The discussion between Bivitri and dozens of camp participants began at around 15:55 WIB.{{Cite web |date=2025-04-15 |title=Bivitri Susanti: Demo Piknik Melawan di Depan DPR Dilindungi Konstitusi |url=https://www.tempo.co/politik/bivitri-susanti-demo-piknik-melawan-di-depan-dpr-dilindungi-konstitusi-1231676 |access-date=2025-04-16 |website=Tempo |language=id |archive-date=20 July 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250720032649/https://www.tempo.co/politik/bivitri-susanti-demo-piknik-melawan-di-depan-dpr-dilindungi-konstitusi-1231676 |url-status=live }} On 20 April, hundreds of people took part in a rally to defend [[Palestine]] in front of the [[US Embassy in Jakarta|US Embassy]] in Gambir, Central Jakarta. There is a police force that provided a special location for the masses within 50 metres of the [[US Embassy in Jakarta|US Embassy]].{{Cite web |date=2025-04-20 |title=Ratusan orang gelar aksi bela Palestina di depan Kedubes AS |url=https://www.antaranews.com/berita/4781613/ratusan-orang-gelar-aksi-bela-palestina-di-depan-kedubes-as |access-date=2025-04-20 |website=Antara News |language=id |archive-date=22 July 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250722020228/https://www.antaranews.com/berita/4781613/ratusan-orang-gelar-aksi-bela-palestina-di-depan-kedubes-as |url-status=live }} The crowd carried various paraphernalia, such as flags, scarves and accessories with [[Flag of Palestine|Palestinian flags]]. The demonstration in the Malang Raya region was initiated by a coalition of student representatives from Universitas Brawijaya and several student organizations based in Malang Raya. The initiators consisted of executive student leaders at the university and faculty levels, as well as members of faculty-based and extra-campus student organizations.{{Cite web |date=2025-12-07 |title=Aksi Demonstrasi Tolak RUU TNI, Mahasiswa FK UB Tegaskan Sikap dan Kecam Kekerasan Aparat |url=https://www.kompasiana.com/aktivisindonesia4806/6934fc37ed6415335a58a8f2/aksi-demonstrasi-tolak-ruu-tni-mahasiswa-fk-ub-tegaskan-sikap-dan-kecam-kekerasan-aparat |access-date=2026-02-06 |website=KOMPASIANA |language=id}} Thousands of people came at 12:00 [[Time in Indonesia|WIB]] and carried various banners and posters featuring demands, with inscriptions such as {{lang|id|Efisiensi untuk Oligarki X, Efisiensi untuk Rakyat ✓}} 'No to Efficiency for the Oligarchy, Yes to Efficiency for the People', and {{lang|id|100 Hari Keadilan Dibunuh}} 'Justice Is Killed in 100 Days'. Presidential portraits of Prabowo and Gibran were defaced with the text {{lang|id|efisienshit}} on their eyes and a cross on their mouths. An hour later, the portraits, alongside used tires, were burned in front of the entrance gate towards DPRD.{{cite web|url=https://daerah.sindonews.com/read/1531397/704/demo-ribuan-orang-di-malang-kritik-efisiensi-prabowo-gibran-foto-dibakar-hingga-tuntut-keadilan-1739862145|title=Demo Ribuan Orang di Malang|website=daerah.sindonews.com|access-date=18 February 2025|archive-date=2 April 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250402011459/https://daerah.sindonews.com/read/1531397/704/demo-ribuan-orang-di-malang-kritik-efisiensi-prabowo-gibran-foto-dibakar-hingga-tuntut-keadilan-1739862145|url-status=live}} After successfully meeting the speaker of DPRD, Amithya Ratnanggani Siraduhita, as well as several fraction leaders, the protesters finally dispersed at 16:00 [[Time in Indonesia|WIB]] during heavy rains.{{cite web|url=https://www.detik.com/jatim/berita/d-7784331/diguyur-hujan-demo-mahasiswa-tolak-efisiensi-di-kota-malang-bubar|title=Diguyur Hujan, Demo Mahasiswa Tolak Efisiensi di Kota Malang Bubar|website=detik.com|access-date=18 February 2025}}[[File:Dewan dan Rakyat Kota Malang - Demonstrasi Indonesia Gelap Februari 2025.jpg|thumb|Members of the Assembly from [[Malang]] City DPRD in dialogue with demonstrators]]On 23 March, protesters with black clothing returned to the Malang DPRD building at 16:00 WIB. Yogyakarta ==== In [[Yogyakarta]], the Jogja Is Calling Alliance has called students and civilians to participate in the protests. Themed {{lang|id|#BersamaRakyat}} ('Together with the People'), the long march started at Abu Bakar Ali parking lot (scheduled initially at 10:00 [[Time in Indonesia|WIB]]), then moved down [[Malioboro Street]].{{Cite news |author=Juno |date=21 February 2025 |title=Large demonstration of Jogja Calling Alliance in Malioboro that ended clean |url=https://bacajogja.id/2025/02/21/demo-besar-besaran-aliansi-jogja-memanggil-di-malioboro-yerujung-bersih/ |access-date=24 March 2025 |work=Baca Jogja }}{{Dead link|date=April 2026 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }} Protesters were dressed in black to align with the viral hashtag. The action, led by students and members of the public, featured posters criticizing the economic, educational, social, and political policies of the Prabowo-Gibran administration. Slogans included: ''"Free Food, Crisis Education," "RIP = Republic of Indonesia Patriarchy," "Let's Fight Against the Infidels," "Don't Let the Military Run Your Kitchen!"'' and ''"Reject [[Oligarchy]], Style ABRI Dual Function."'' The movement, branded Jogja Memanggil, further demanded the resignation of President Prabowo and Vice President Gibran and the dissolution of the Red and White Cabinet, citing incompetence and a perceived lack of alignment with public interests. Protesters also condemned Prabowo's response during [[Gerindra]]'s anniversary event on 15 February 2025, where he reportedly said ''"Ndasmu!"'' (a Javanese insult) to critics. Demonstrators viewed this remark as unacceptable for a head of state. Just over 100 days into the new administration, the group claims the government has already caused significant harm, leading them to call for its immediate resignation and structural overhaul.{{Cite news |author=Pribadi Wicaksono |author2=Nabiila Azzahra |author3=Yuni Rohmawati |author4=Alif Ilham Fajriadi |date=22 February 2025 |title=Dark Indonesia Action Continues in Jakarta, Palembang, and Yogyakarta |url=https://www.tempo.co/politik/aksi-indonesia-gelap-terus-menyala-di-jakarta-palembang-dan-yogyakarta-1210565 |work=Tempo |access-date=24 March 2025 |archive-date=26 April 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250426141604/https://www.tempo.co/politik/aksi-indonesia-gelap-terus-menyala-di-jakarta-palembang-dan-yogyakarta-1210565 |url-status=live }} The protestors would arrive at the Special Region of Yogyakarta DPRD building at 12:15 WIB. The graffiti reads: "Keep fighting, there are too many victims already."]]Amidst concern on an upcoming draft law, the impetus for the second wave of the 2025 Indonesian protests started in Yogyakarta when the Jogja Memanggil Alliance held the 'Dark Indonesia' Volume 2 demonstration on 11 March 2025, walking from Abu Bakar Ali Parking Lot to Yogyakarta's Zero Point in the pouring rain. Dozens of students and activists demanded President Prabowo Subianto and Vice President [[Gibran Rakabuming Raka]] resign, while carrying posters criticising the government. The demonstration themed 'Ruwat Ruweting Penguasa Durno' was based on the concept of ruwatan in Javanese culture, which means cleansing from harm. Alliance spokesperson Hidayah said the ruwatan tradition is relevant to the current situation, where people need to be free from a corrupt regime. In addition to the theatrical action, the demonstrators highlighted BPI [[Danantara]], the government's strategic investment agency, which is chaired by a number of Prabowo-Gibran cabinet officials such as [[Rosan Roeslani]], [[Erick Thohir]], and [[Sri Mulyani]]. They argued that these appointments violated the Law on State Ministries. Other figures such as Jokowi, [[Susilo Bambang Yudhoyono]], and former British PM [[Tony Blair]] were also criticised for their involvement in Danantara's advisory board and supervisory board. The crowd also criticised economic policies, including the planned 12% VAT hike, the scarcity of [[Petroleum|BBM]], budget cuts outside of defence, as well as weak oversight that opened up loopholes for corruption. The [[Indonesia Corruption Watch]] (ICW) recorded 119 cases of [[State-owned enterprises|BUMN]] corruption in 2016–2021 with state losses of IDR 40 trillion. Demonstrators criticised Prabowo for being anti-criticism, especially after his 'ndasmu' statement that offended the people regarding the Free Nutritious Meal programme.{{Cite news |last=Maharani |first=Shinta |date=11 March 2025 |title=Demonstration of Dark Indonesia Volume Two in Yogyakarta Demand Prabowo-Gibran Resign |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250326161836/https://www.tempo.co/politics/demonstration-indonesia-gelap-jilid-two-in-yogyakarta-demands-prabowo-gibran-resign--1218248 |url-status=live |title=Dosen UGM Liburkan Mahasiswanya untuk Gabung Aksi Tolak Revisi UU TNI Siang ini |url-status=live }} This demonstration was joined by the Jogja Memanggil alliance. In addition to being followed by the Jogja Memanggil Alliance, a number of elements ranging from students at various campuses in Yogyakarta to activists were also seen accompanying, including the Cik Ditiro Forum.{{Cite web |last=Muhid |first=Hendrik Khoirul |date=24 March 2025 |title=The Sundries of the Jogja Memanggil Alliance Demonstrating Against the Ratification of the TNI Bill |url=https://www.tempo.co/politik/serba-serbi-aliansi-jogja-memanggil-unjuk-rasa-tolak-pengesahan-ruu-tni-1223359 |access-date=25 March 2025 |website=Tempo |archive-date=23 November 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251123020523/https://www.tempo.co/politik/serba-serbi-aliansi-jogja-memanggil-unjuk-rasa-tolak-pengesahan-ruu-tni-1223359 |url-status=live }} Police were deployed, including tactical vehicles, to secure the action. The spokesperson for the action, Bung Koes, argued that the TNI Bill had the potential to threaten democracy by authorising soldiers to hold civilian positions. Marsinah, from the Jogja Memanggil Alliance, said the bill risked reviving [[authoritarianism]] in the style of the [[New Order (Indonesia)|New Order]]. The masses also criticised the ratification process, which was considered to be closed and procedurally flawed.[[File:Suasana di gedung DPRD Provinsi Daerah Istimewa Yogyakarta saat berlangsungnya unjuk rasa menolak UU TNI pada 20 Maret 2025.png|thumb|Occupation of the Yogyakarta DPRD building during the demonstration against the TNI Law, 20 March 2025]]Though initially peaceful, the action turned tense at around 3.45 pm, when the crowd began to graffiti the walls of the DIY DPRD with graffiti such as 'Reject the TNI Law', 'Adili Prabowo' and [[Anti-police sentiment|anti-police]] calls such as '[[ACAB]]' and '1312'. The crowd also burned garbage, set off [[firecracker]]s, lit [[bonfire]]s, and threw things down the hall. Until the evening, the crowd remained and planned to stay overnight in the courtyard of the DPRD DIY. They set up tents, built bonfires, broke their fast, played games, and continued to hold a free pulpit while giving speeches. The action was interspersed with poetry reading and singing songs to encourage the protesters. The masses also called for [[satay]], {{ill|wedang ronde|id}}, and beverage vendors into the DIY DPRD environment for a meal break. Despite an ultimatum from the police, the Yogyakartan DPRD office were vandalised by thrown litters and graffiti and protesters threatened to stay in front of the office indefinitely.{{cite web |title=Massa Aksi Bertahan di DPRD DIY, Polisi Beri Waktu Sejam untuk Bubar |url=https://m.harianjogja.com/jogjapolitan/read/2025/03/20/510/1207841/massa-aksi-bertahan-di-dprd-diy-polisi-beri-waktu-sejam-untuk-bubar |access-date=21 March 2025 |website=harianjogja.com}} [[File:Polisi mengawasi unjuk rasa di gedung DPRD Provinsi Daerah Istimewa Yogyakarta, 20 Maret 2025.png|thumb|Police monitoring the demonstration at the Regional House of Representatives building of the Special Region of Yogyakarta, March 20, 2025.]] The police asked the demonstrators in the yard of the DIY DPRD to disperse using loudspeakers. The demonstrators asked for permission to stay until morning, but the police only gave them one hour. Yogyakarta Police Chief Senior Commissioner Aditya Surya Dharma stated, "Please discuss it, we'll give you one hour." Meanwhile, representatives of the masses hoped that the demonstration could last all night with the concept of "camping together" to voice their opinions. However, the police stuck to their initial decision, limiting the time of the demonstration to 00.00 WIB.{{Cite news |author1=Wisang Seto Pangaribowo |author2=Gloria Setyvani |date=20 March 2025 |title=Massa Aksi Jogja Memanggil Minta Demo Sampai Pagi, Polisi Beri Waktu 1 Jam |url=https://yogyakarta.kompas.com/read/2025/03/20/232657478/massa-aksi-jogja-memanggil-minta-demo-sampai-pagi-polisi-beri-waktu-1-jam |access-date=25 March 2025 |work=Kompas Yogyakarta |archive-date=26 March 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250326172229/https://yogyakarta.kompas.com/read/2025/03/20/232657478/massa-aksi-jogja-memanggil-minta-demo-sampai-pagi-polisi-beri-waktu-1-jam |url-status=live }} At around 00.40 WIB, the police deployed two Mobile Brigade (Brimob) tactical vehicles and dozens of riot police. Chaos ensued, with bottles and firecrackers being thrown at the police. Water cannons were used to push back the demonstrators.{{Cite web |last=Rinepta |first=Adji G |date=21 March 2025 |title=Demo Tolak UU TNI di DPRD DIY Ricuh, Water Canon Dikerahkan |url=https://www.detik.com/jogja/berita/d-7833955/demo-tolak-uu-tni-di-dprd-diy-ricuh-water-canon-dikerahkan |access-date=25 March 2025 |website=Detik |archive-date=28 March 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250328204834/https://www.detik.com/jogja/berita/d-7833955/demo-tolak-uu-tni-di-dprd-diy-ricuh-water-canon-dikerahkan |url-status=live }} Meanwhile, outside the DIY DPRD complex, from the south side there was another group of people trying to approach the demonstrators rejecting the TNI Law. This unidentified group in civilian clothes uttered various insults at the demonstrators rejecting the TNI Law who they considered to be the cause of the riot. A number of police personnel were seen blocking the group of residents so that they would not clash with the protesters who remained in front of the DPRD building. The police prevented a clash between the two groups. The Secretary of the DIY DPRD, Yudi Ismono, said he could not yet detail the total losses due to vandalism. The DIY DPRD building, which is a cultural heritage site, experienced extensive spray-painted graffiti, as well as an incident of burning garbage. Police remained on site to prevent further damage. On 29 March, Indonesian Mothers' Voice held a protest at [[Titik Nol Kilometer Yogyakarta]] on [[Jalan Malioboro|Malioboro Street]]{{Cite web |date=29 March 2025 |title=Suara Ibu di Yogyakarta Desak Polisi dan Tentara Hentikan Kekerasan terhadap Mahasiswa |url=https://www.tempo.co/politik/suara-ibu-di-yogyakarta-desak-polisi-dan-tentara-hentikan-kekerasan-terhadap-mahasiswa--1225649 |access-date=2025-03-29 |website=Tempo |language=id |archive-date=27 July 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250727124837/https://www.tempo.co/politik/suara-ibu-di-yogyakarta-desak-polisi-dan-tentara-hentikan-kekerasan-terhadap-mahasiswa--1225649/ |url-status=live }} On 15 April, hundreds of people who are members of the Ulama and Activist Defence Team (TPUA) came to the Faculty of Forestry, [[Gadjah Mada University|Universitas Gadjah Mada]] (UGM), [[Sleman Regency|Sleman]], Yogyakarta to ask for clarification on the alleged fake diploma of the 7th President of Indonesia, [[Joko Widodo]]. They gathered in front of Room 109 of the Faculty of Forestry UGM around 07:45 a.m, including mothers. Not long after, four representatives of the protesters entered Room 109 of the Faculty of Forestry UGM to attend an audience with the rector regarding Jokowi's diploma. Meanwhile, [[Amien Rais]] was also among the crowd. He said that UGM's explanation of Jokowi's previous diploma did not prove enough and instead seemed to be spinning.{{Cite web |title=Drama Ijazah Jokowi Berlanjut, UGM Jadi Sasaran Demo Ratusan Orang |url=https://jogja.suara.com/read/2025/04/15/103331/drama-ijazah-jokowi-berlanjut-ugm-jadi-sasaran-demo-ratusan-orang |access-date=2025-04-15 |website=Suarajogja.id |language=id |archive-date=24 June 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250624070057/https://jogja.suara.com/read/2025/04/15/103331/drama-ijazah-jokowi-berlanjut-ugm-jadi-sasaran-demo-ratusan-orang |url-status=live }}{{Cite web |title=Soal Keaslian Ijazah Jokowi, Amien Rais Berkata Begini |url=https://www.jpnn.com/news/soal-keaslian-ijazah-jokowi-amien-rais-berkata-begini |access-date=2025-04-15 |website=JPNN.com |language=id |archive-date=10 August 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250810043251/https://www.jpnn.com/news/soal-keaslian-ijazah-jokowi-amien-rais-berkata-begini |url-status=live }} ==== Surakarta ==== In [[Surakarta]], students started walking backward{{cite web |last1=Media |first1=Kompas Cyber |date=19 February 2025 |title=Demo "Indonesia Gelap" di Solo dan Makna Jalan Mundur Massa |url=https://regional.kompas.com/read/2025/02/19/223435078/demo-indonesia-gelap-di-solo-dan-makna-jalan-mundur-massa |access-date=19 February 2025 |website=regional.kompas.com}} from Makutho Monument at 14:00 [[Time in Indonesia|WIB]], and arrived front of the Surakarta DPRD building at Adi Sucipto Road at 15:40 WIB, on 19 February. The protesters also carried various anti-government banners and burned used tires. Their action was guarded by hundreds of joint personnel from the military, police, and the Department of Transportation.{{cite web |title=Demo Indonesia Gelap di Solo, Mahasiswa Blokade Jalan Adi Sucipto |url=https://www.metrotvnews.com/read/bD2CMq4B-demo-indonesia-gelap-di-solo-mahasiswa-blokade-jalan-adi-sucipto |access-date=19 February 2025 |website=Metro TV}} Coordinator Syaiful interpreted that a backward walk represents that "the nation is experiencing a setback". They threatened if their six demands were not realised in three days, they would return with a larger number of protesters.{{cite web |title=Bawa 6 Poin Tuntutan, Mahasiswa se-Soloraya Akan Kembali ke DPRD Jika 3 Hari Tak Terpenuhi |url=https://solo.tribunnews.com/2025/02/20/bawa-6-poin-tuntutan-mahasiswa-se-soloraya-akan-kembali-ke-dprd-jika-3-hari-tak-terpenuhi |access-date=20 February 2025 |website=Tribun}} On 19 March, hundreds of [[Sebelas Maret University]] (UNS) students held a protest rally at the Surakarta City Council. The students unfurled white banners with various writings, such as ‘Return TNI to Barracks’, as well as the hashtags ''#hapuskanRUUTNI'', ''#TolakRUUTNI'', ''#Pukulmundur'', and ''#Supremasisipil''.{{Cite web |date=19 March 2025 |title=Mahasiswa Demo Tolak RUU TNI di DPRD Solo, "Pulangkan TNI ke Barak" |url=https://regional.kompas.com/read/2025/03/19/165529078/mahasiswa-demo-tolak-ruu-tni-di-dprd-solo-pulangkan-tni-ke-barak |access-date=16 April 2025 |website=Kompas.com}} The President of BEM UNS 2025 said that his side hoped that DPRD Surakarta could convey their aspirations to the central government not to pass the TNI Law. He said that the TNI Law could bring back [[New Order (Indonesia)|New Order]] Volume 2.{{Cite web |last=Putra |first=Agil Trisetiawan |title=Mahasiswa UNS Demo Tolak RUU TNI di Depan DPRD Solo |url=https://www.detik.com/jateng/berita/d-7831638/mahasiswa-uns-demo-tolak-ruu-tni-di-depan-dprd-solo |access-date=2025-04-16 |website=detikjateng |language=id-ID}} On 20 March, students and the public participated in the demonstration against the ratification of the TNI Law wearing all black clothes. The action coordinator said the demonstration at the Surakarta DPRD building was carried out as a form of disappointment over the passing of the revised TNI Law by the House of Representatives.{{Cite web |last=NV |first=Tara Wahyu |title=Massa Protes Pengesahan Revisi UU TNI Gelar Aksi di DPRD Solo |url=https://www.detik.com/jateng/berita/d-7833444/massa-protes-pengesahan-revisi-uu-tni-gelar-aksi-di-dprd-solo |access-date=2025-04-16 |website=detikjateng |language=id-ID}}{{Cite web |date=2025-03-20 |title=Undang-undang TNI: DPR sahkan Revisi UU TNI, mahasiswa gelar demonstrasi di berbagai kota – 'Demokrasi telah dibunuh di DPR' |url=https://www.bbc.com/indonesia/articles/c0mwy89rggko |access-date=2025-04-16 |website=BBC News Indonesia |language=id}} On 16 April, protesters from the [[Ulama and Activist Defence Team]] (TPUA) who wanted to see the authenticity of the diploma of the 7th President, [[Joko Widodo]], came to his residence.{{Cite web |last=NV |first=Tara Wahyu |title=Usai UGM, Massa Geruduk Rumah Jokowi Tanya Keaslian Ijazah |url=https://www.detik.com/jateng/berita/d-7871167/usai-ugm-massa-geruduk-rumah-jokowi-tanya-keaslian-ijazah |access-date=2025-04-16 |website=detikjateng |language=id-ID}} The atmosphere was heated around Jokowi's residence when the TPUA camp met with dozens of Jokowi's supporters who had been waiting since morning and then subsided after security officers, both the police on guard and the ''[[Presidential Security Force of Indonesia|Paspampres]]'', allowed representatives to meet with Jokowi. There were at least four representatives who met Jokowi inside his residence, one of whom was TPUA Deputy, [[Chair Rizal Fadillah]].{{Cite web |last=Nugroho |first=Febri |date=2025-04-16 |title=Massa TPUA Geruduk Rumah Jokowi, Desak Tunjukkan Ijazah Asli |url=https://tirto.id/massa-tpua-geruduk-rumah-jokowi-desak-tunjukkan-ijazah-asli-haAW |access-date=2025-04-16 |website=tirto.id |language=id}} He confirmed this when met by reporters after the meeting with Jokowi. He said the purpose of their visit to Jokowi's residence was not only to stay in touch in the atmosphere of Eid al-Fitr like other residents, but also to connect with Jokowi's diploma. The meeting lasted about 30 minutes. However, Jokowi did not show his diploma to them.{{Cite web |date=2025-04-16 |title=Jokowi Ogah Tunjukkan Ijazah saat Pendemo Sambangi Kediamannya |url=https://www.tempo.co/politik/jokowi-ogah-tunjukkan-ijazah-saat-pendemo-sambangi-kediamannya-1231960 |access-date=2025-04-16 |website=Tempo |language=id}} Prior to the meeting with [[Ulama and Activist Defence Team]] TPUA, Joko Widodo invited dozens of media crews including [[CNN Indonesia]] to enter his residence. However, Jokowi did not allow media crews to take pictures during the meeting and was asked to collect mobile phones and cameras. He showed his diplomas from elementary to high school, and also his undergraduate degree at UGM. The UGM diploma shown by Jokowi is very similar to the image circulating on social media. However, Jokowi was reluctant to confirm the similarity of the circulating diploma photo with his own.{{Cite web |date=16 April 2025 |title=Jokowi Tunjukkan Ijazah ke Wartawan: Tapi Jangan Difoto Ya |url=https://www.cnnindonesia.com/nasional/20250416124135-20-1219377/jokowi-tunjukkan-ijazah-ke-wartawan-tapi-jangan-difoto-ya?utm_campaign=cnnsocmed&utm_medium=oa&utm_source=twitter |access-date=16 April 2025 |website=CNN Indonesia}} ==== Other protests in Java ==== In [[Serang]], students organised a sit-in at the Ciceri intersection on 20 March 2025.{{cite web|url=https://news.detik.com/berita/d-7833776/demo-tolak-ruu-tni-mahasiswa-tutup-simpang-ciceri-serang-malam-ini|title=Demo Tolak RUU TNI, Mahasiswa Tutup Simpang Ciceri Serang Malam Ini|website=news.detik.com|access-date=21 March 2025}} In [[Bogor]], students illegally held a protest on 27 March. web|url=https://www.detik.com/jabar/berita/d-7833623/demo-tolak-pengesahan-uu-tni-di-sukabumi-massa-bertahan-hingga-malam|title=Demo Tolak Pengesahan UU TNI di Sukabumi, Massa Bertahan hingga
