According to ''[[Detik.com]]'', the Cirebon parliament's office equipment was looted by protestors whilst police dispersed protestors in Pekalongan.{{Cite news |date=30 August 2025 |title=Protesters set fire to Indonesian parliament buildings in several provinces |url=https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/protesters-set-fire-indonesian-parliament-buildings-several-provinces-2025-08-30/ |work=[[Reuters]]}}{{Cite news |date=30 August 2025 |title=Fire kills three people in Indonesia after protesters torch council buildings |url=https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/aug/30/fire-kills-three-people-in-indonesia-after-protesters-storm-council-buildings-in-the-wake-of-taxi-drivers-death |work=[[The Guardian]]}} === Nusa Tenggara Islands === In [[Denpasar]], students under Bali Is Not Silent Alliance arrived at the building of Bali Regional House of Representatives on 11:30 [[Time in Indonesia|WITA]], and carried a banner with inscription {{lang|id|Tut Wuri Efisiensi}}, a play on Indonesian education motto {{lang|id|Tut Wuri Handayani}}. Ten minutes later, they were invited into the building's {{lang|id|[[wantilan]]}} (pavilion) by acting secretary I Gusti Ngurah Wiryanata to voice their demands.{{cite web|url=https://tirto.id/aksi-indonesia-gelap-di-bali-tolak-pemangkasan-dana-pendidikan-g8pe|title=Aksi Indonesia Gelap di Bali Tolak Pemangkasan Dana Pendidikan|website=tirto.id|date=17 February 2025 |access-date=17 February 2025}} Students from [[Udayana University]] have announced plans for further protests on 31 March, following the emergence of an agreement letter between [[Indonesian Army]] and the university, which was perceived as a military attempt to intervene the education sector.{{cite web|url=https://www.tempo.co/politik/mahasiswa-universitas-udayana-akan-demo-tolak-kerja-sama-kampus-dengan-tni-ad-1226673|title=Mahasiswa Universitas Udayana Akan Demo Tolak Kerja Sama Kampus dengan TNI AD|website=tempo.co|date=2 April 2025 |access-date=2025-04-02}} In [[Mataram (city)|Mataram]], students' union of the [[University of Mataram]] (BEM UNRAM), stated that they would participate in protest on 20 February with president of the university's student union already departed to Jakarta to coordinate the protest with the one led by BEM SI.{{Cite web |last=Citra |first=Nathea |title=BEM Unram Turut Bergabung di Demo 'Indonesia Gelap' Besok |url=https://www.detik.com/bali/nusra/d-7786352/bem-unram-turut-bergabung-di-demo-indonesia-gelap-besok |access-date=19 February 2025 |website=detikbali |language=id-ID}} They carried a bier as a form of protest.{{cite web|url=https://news.detik.com/video/250220101/video-mahasiswa-mataram-gelar-demo-indonesia-gelap-di-depan-kantor-dprd-ntb|title=Video: Mahasiswa Mataram Gelar Demo 'Indonesia Gelap' di Depan Kantor DPRD NTB|website=news.detik.com|access-date=20 February 2025}} On 25 March, hundreds of students under West Nusa Tenggara Students and Society Alliance, protested front of the West Nusa Tenggara DPRD building. Speaker of the legislature, Baiq Isvie Rupaeda, subsequently announced that their demands would be delivered to the central DPR.{{cite web|url=https://www.cnnindonesia.com/nasional/20250325161525-20-1212949/massa-aliansi-mahasiswa-dan-rakyat-ntb-demo-tolak-uu-tni-di-mataram|title=Massa Aliansi Mahasiswa dan Rakyat NTB Demo Tolak UU TNI di Mataram|website=CNN Indonesia|access-date=25 March 2025}} In [[Kupang]], students gathered in front off East Nusa Tenggara governor office, also known as [[Sasando Building]] to protest the budget cuts for education.{{Cite web |title=Deretan Aksi Demo Mahasiswa di Makassar-NTT Tolak Efisiensi Anggaran Pendidikan Presiden Prabowo |url=https://www.kompas.tv/nasional/575036/deretan-aksi-demo-mahasiswa-di-makassar-ntt-tolak-efisiensi-anggaran-pendidikan-presiden-prabowo |access-date=19 February 2025 |website=Kompas.tv |language=id}} On 24 March, students from Cipayung Plus Alliance protested front of the East Nusa Tenggara DPRD building.{{cite web|url=https://news.detik.com/berita/d-7839720/mahasiswa-demo-tolak-uu-tni-di-ntt-khawatir-dwifungsi-hidup-lagi|title=Mahasiswa Demo Tolak UU TNI di NTT, Khawatir Dwifungsi Hidup Lagi|website=news.detik.com|access-date=24 March 2025}} === Kalimantan === {| class="infobox selfreference" style="width:22em;" |All dates in [[Central Kalimantan]] and [[West Kalimantan]] are in West Indonesia Time (WIB; [[UTC+07:00]]); and all dates in [[East Kalimantan]], [[North Kalimantan]], and [[South Kalimantan]] are in Central Indonesia Time (WITA; [[UTC+08:00]]). |} In [[Pontianak]], on February, dozens of students arrived at West Kalimantan DPRD for protesting.{{Cite web |title=Mahasiswa di Kalbar Tolak MBG dan Efisiensi Anggaran |url=https://kumparan.com/hipontianak/mahasiswa-di-kalbar-tolak-mbg-dan-efisiensi-anggaran-24X2lEBmBpN |access-date=19 February 2025 |website=kumparan |language=id-ID}} On 27 March, several students from Panca Bhakti University protested at West Kalimantan DPRD, but their demands were later responded by several parliament members.{{cite web|url=https://pontianakpost.jawapos.com/metropolis/1465824501/demo-mahasiswa-pontianak-menolak-uu-tni|title=Demo Mahasiswa Pontianak Menolak UU TNI|website=pontianakpost.jawapos.com|access-date=2025-03-28}} In [[Palangka Raya]], students from various local universities, mainly [[University of Palangka Raya]] (UPR), Muhammadiyah Palangka Raya University, State Islamic Institute of Palangka Raya, and State Hindu Institute of Palangka Raya, protested at the building of Central Kalimantan DPRD. They danced with [[Prabowo Subianto 2024 presidential campaign|Prabowo's campaign]] song ''Oke Gas 2'' by Richard Jersey, as a form of political satire, while also burning used tires. Some protesters also shouted out {{lang|id|Adili Jokowi}} ('Bring Jokowi into Justice').{{cite web|last1=Media |first1=Kompas Cyber |url=https://regional.kompas.com/read/2025/02/19/210306878/demo-indonesia-gelap-di-kalteng-mahasiswa-putar-lagu-oke-gas-sambil-teriak|title=Demo "Indonesia Gelap" di Kalteng, Mahasiswa Putar Lagu Oke Gas Sambil Teriak Adili Jokowi|website=regional.kompas.com|access-date=19 February 2025 |date=19 February 2025 }} The students threatened the speaker of the Central Kalimantan province's parliament (DPRD) a second wave of protest in Monday with bigger mass if their demands are not met.{{Cite web |date=19 February 2025 |title=Mahasiswa se-Kota Palangka Raya Demo 'Indonesia Gelap', Tolak Efisiensi Anggaran Pendidikan |url=https://www.intimnews.com/mahasiswa-se-kota-palangka-raya-demo-indonesia-gelap-tolak-efisiensi-anggaran-pendidikan/ |access-date=19 February 2025 |website=Intim News |language=id}} [[File:Indonesia_Gelap_Protest_UNRAS_DPRD_KalSel.jpg|thumb|{{ill|Ratu Samban University|id|Universitas Ratu Samban}} (UNRAS) Students hassle with the police after attempting to plaster anti-government banners on the [[South Kalimantan]] DPRD, 18 February 2025]] In [[Banjarmasin]], hundreds of students, as well as the civil society, protested in front of the building of South Kalimantan DPRD. They criticised high public approval rates of the government by various survey results, and called them not in accordance with the realities.{{cite web|url=https://banjarmasin.tribunnews.com/2025/02/17/demo-di-dprd-kalsel-bem-survei-kepuasan-80-persen-prabowo-gibran-tak-sesuai-fakta-lapangan|title=Demo di DPRD Kalsel, BEM: Survei Kepuasan 80 Persen Prabowo-Gibran Tak Sesuai Fakta Lapangan|website=banjarmasin.tribunnews.com|access-date=18 February 2025}} In [[Kotabaru Regency|Kotabaru]], on 30 March, dozens of people held a protest front of the headquarters of Military District Commando 1004, in support of the Armed Forces Law.{{cite web|url=https://redkal.com/berita/lintas-kalsel/balangan/dukung-ruu-tni-masyarakat-kotabaru-lakukan-demo-simpatik-di-depan-makodim/|title=Dukung RUU TNI, Masyarakat Kotabaru Lakukan Demo Simpatik di Depan Makodim|website=redkal.com|date=30 March 2025 |access-date=2025-03-31}} In [[Balikpapan]], students under the Students' Alliance of the Oil City started a long march from four-way intersection at Balikpapan Plaza towards Balikpapan DPRD. After arriving at the building, it was marked by jostlings between protesters and policemen at the entrance door.{{cite web|url=https://kaltimpost.jawapos.com/utama/2385675116/demo-indonesia-gelap-mahasiswa-balikpapan-tidak-bubar-sebelum-perwakilan-dprd-mendengarkan-tuntutan|title=Demo Indonesia Gelap Mahasiswa Balikpapan Tidak Bubar Sebelum Perwakilan DPRD Mendengarkan Tuntutan|website=kaltimpost.jawapos.com|access-date=21 February 2025}} They additionally criticised policies by the city's local government.{{cite web|url=https://kaltimpost.jawapos.com/balikpapan/2385675225/aksi-indonesia-gelap-di-balikpapan-mahasiswa-juga-kritik-kebijakan-pemerintah-kota|title=Aksi Indonesia Gelap di Balikpapan: Mahasiswa Juga Kritik Kebijakan Pemerintah Kota|website=kaltimpost.jawapos.com|access-date=21 February 2025}} The police dispersed them after exceeding the limit at 18:00, and later arrested 6 protesters, suspected of being provocateurs and against the officers.{{cite web|url=https://kaltimpost.jawapos.com/balikpapan/2385677132/polresta-balikpapan-benarkan-amankan-enam-mahasiswa-saat-demo-indonesia-gelap-sangidun-mereka-melawan-petugas|title=Polresta Balikpapan Benarkan Amankan Enam Mahasiswa saat Demo Indonesia Gelap, Sangidun: Mereka Melawan Petugas|website=kaltimpost.jawapos.com|access-date=22 February 2025}} [[File:Rocky Gerung in 2020 (cropped close 2-3).jpg|thumb|273x273px|Rocky Gerung in 2020]] In [[Samarinda]], thousands of students protested in front of the East Kalimantan DPRD building. Political commentator [[Rocky Gerung]] gave a speech to motivate the protesters.{{cite web|url=https://kaltimpost.jawapos.com/utama/2385656048/mantap-rocky-gerung-bakar-semangat-mahasiswa-samarinda-menuju-aksi-indonesia-gelap-di-dprd-kaltim|title=Mantap! Rocky Gerung Bakar Semangat Mahasiswa Samarinda Menuju Aksi Indonesia Gelap di DPRD Kaltim|website=kaltimpost.jawapos.com|access-date=17 February 2025}} The protesters clashed with the local police after attempting to enter the building, and they fired a water cannon on the protesters. As a result, the protesters were treated back to [[Samarinda Islamic Center Mosque]].{{cite web|url=https://www.antarafoto.com/id/view/2450725/polisi-bubarkan-unjuk-rasa-mahasiswa-di-samarinda|title=Polisi Bubarkan Unjuk Rasa Mahasiswa di Samarinda|website=antarafoto.com|access-date=17 February 2025}}{{cite web |last1=Media |first1=Kompas Cyber |url=https://regional.kompas.com/read/2025/02/17/195716178/ribuan-mahasiswa-kaltim-gelar-aksi-di-dprd-tuntut-pembatalan-inpres-1-2025|title=Ribuan Mahasiswa Kaltim Gelar Aksi di DPRD, Tuntut Pembatalan Inpres 1/2025|website=regional.kompas.com|date=17 February 2025 |access-date=17 February 2025}} On 21 March, hundreds of students from various organisations protested front of East Kalimantan DPRD. They scattered flowers as a symbolism for dying democracy, and carried a banner in opposition to the ratification of revised Armed Forces Law.{{cite web|url=https://jurnalborneo.com/ratusan-mahasiswa-samarinda-demo-tolak-revisi-uu-tni-sebut-demokrasi-terancam/|title=Ratusan Mahasiswa Samarinda Demo Tolak Revisi UU TNI, Sebut Demokrasi Terancam|website=jurnalborneo.com|date=21 March 2025 |access-date=24 March 2025}} In [[Tarakan]], on 21 March 2025, Civil Supremacy Alliance, consisting of 11 students' institutions, held a protest in front of Tarakan DPRD during rains. It was also marked with burning of used tires.{{cite web|url=https://www.detik.com/kalimantan/berita/d-7834548/aliansi-supremasi-sipil-tarakan-tolak-revisi-uu-tni-tuntut-pengajuan-jr-ke-mk|title=Aliansi Supremasi Sipil Tarakan Tolak Revisi UU TNI, Tuntut Pengajuan JR ke MK|website=detik.com|access-date=2025-04-04}} On 26 March, the alliance announced for further demonstrations, after DPRD did not respond to the ultimatum issued by them previous day. Previously, they held a consolidation meeting attended by 7 representatives from 5 students' organisations.{{cite web|url=https://www.detik.com/kalimantan/berita/d-7842103/kecewa-sikap-dprd-aliansi-sipil-tarakan-siap-aksi-tolak-uu-tni-jilid-ii|title=Kecewa Sikap DPRD, Aliansi Sipil Tarakan Siap Aksi Tolak UU TNI Jilid II|website=detik.com|access-date=2025-04-04}} === Sulawesi === ==== Makassar ==== In [[Makassar]], the following protests (except the protests in August) share very similar patterns, including burning used tires and blocking roads with a truck, effectively causing long traffic jams and creating tensions between protesters and drivers.{{cite web|url=https://fajar.co.id/2025/02/21/demo-indonesiagelap-di-makassar-bikin-macet-pengguna-jalan-kita-paham-tapi-tersiksa/|title=Demo #IndonesiaGelap di Makassar Bikin Macet, Pengguna Jalan: Kita Paham tapi Tersiksa|website=fajar.co.id|date=21 February 2025 |access-date=21 February 2025}} On 17 February, students protested at Perintis Kemerdekaan Road, effectively blocking the Trans-Sulawesi Road. They also burned used tires and held back a truck as a stage for protesters.{{cite web|url=https://kumparan.com/kumparannews/demo-indonesiagelap-mahasiswa-makassar-bakar-ban-blokade-jalan-trans-sulawesi-24WIG8cxpOr|title=Demo #IndonesiaGelap Mahasiswa Makassar: Bakar Ban, Blokade Jalan Trans Sulawesi|website=kumparan.com|access-date=17 February 2025}} A day later, students under AMPERA conducted protests at AP Pettarani Road, Rappocini. They also burned used tires and blocked the road with a container truck.{{cite web|url=https://fajar.co.id/2025/02/18/demo-indonesia-gelap-di-makassar-mahasiswa-kritik-pemotongan-anggaran-pendidikan/|title=Demo 'Indonesia Gelap' di Makassar, Mahasiswa Kritik Pemotongan Anggaran Pendidikan|website=fajar.co.id|date=18 February 2025 |access-date=18 February 2025}} Next day, students under Student Activists' Movement (GAM) also blocked the same road (AP Pettarani Road) with a truck and burned used tires.{{cite web|url=https://sulawesi.bisnis.com/read/20250219/539/1841068/mahasiswa-demo-di-makassar-tuntut-kaji-ulang-mbg-hingga-tolak-danantara|title=Mahasiswa Demo di Makassar, Tuntut Kaji Ulang MBG Hingga Tolak Danantara|website=sulawesi.bisnis.com|date=19 February 2025 |access-date=19 February 2025}} Another protest occurred at Sultan Alauddin Road, attended by students from [[Alauddin Islamic State University]] and carried various banners and pamphlets with critical messages. They also burned used tires.{{cite web|url=https://fajar.co.id/2025/02/20/oke-gas-tagar-indonesia-gelap-bergema-di-aksi-mahasiswa-makassar-mahasiswa-efisiensi-untuk-irit-masyarakat-menjerit/|title=Oke Gas Tagar Indonesia Gelap Bergema di Aksi Mahasiswa Makassar, Mahasiswa: Efisiensi Untuk Irit, Masyarakat Menjerit|website=fajar.co.id|date=20 February 2025 |access-date=20 February 2025}} Next day, Makassar Students' Alliance organised a protest under a flyover and then moved towards South Sulawesi DPRD building at Urip Sumoharjo Road. They also held two trucks as stages for the protests.{{cite web|url=https://inikata.co.id/2025/02/21/ratusan-massa-aksi-demo-indonesia-gelap-kini-sambangi-dprd-sulsel/|title=Ratusan Massa Aksi Demo "Indonesia Gelap" Kini Sambangi DPRD Sulsel|website=inikata.co.id|date=21 February 2025 |access-date=21 February 2025}} Later, the protesters burned used tires, sang together "[[Buruh Tani]]" by Marjinal, and pulling the barbed wires.{{cite web|url=https://www.cnnindonesia.com/nasional/20250221161340-20-1201072/memanas-massa-indonesia-gelap-tarik-kawat-berduri-bongkar-barikade|title=Memanas, Massa Indonesia Gelap Tarik Kawat Berduri Bongkar Barikade|website=cnnindonesia.com|access-date=21 February 2025}} The protesters began to disperse at 19:05 [[Time in Indonesia|WITA]], and police chief of Makassar, Arya Perdana, claimed that their aspirations have arrived into South Sulawesi DPRD.{{cite web|url=https://makassar.tribunnews.com/2025/02/21/massa-aksi-indonesia-gelap-di-dprd-sulsel-bubar-kapolrestabes-makassar-klaim-aspirasi-telah-sampai|title=Massa Aksi Indonesia Gelap di DPRD Sulsel Bubar, Kapolrestabes Makassar Klaim Aspirasi Telah Sampai|website=makassar.tribunnews.com|access-date=21 February 2025}} However, as of 19:40 [[Time in Indonesia|WITA]], students from the [[State University of Makassar]] (UNM) and a group of drivers, were seen fighting each other using stones and bows.{{cite web|url=https://sulsel.idntimes.com/news/indonesia/darsil-yahya-mustari-1/demo-indonesia-gelap-di-makassar-sekelompok-orang-serang-mahasiswa-c1c2?page=all&_gl=1*iyyu2d*_ga*QXV6NDl1S3Y2MkNfLTE4RVROUUx1QnVGTzNtYWxCYkR0eEZvNTlZejZlcmJTZDZfclk5VGUxNmJxbERLNXNBbg..*_ga_TT180KERFB*MTc0MDE0MDU3My4yLjAuMTc0MDE0MDU3My4wLjAuMA..|title=Demo Indonesia Gelap di Makassar: Sekelompok Orang Serang Mahasiswa|website=sulsel.idntimes.com|date=21 February 2025 |access-date=21 February 2025}} As a result, 6 people, accused of being provocateurs, were arrested by the local police while hiding within the campus of UNM,{{cite web|url=https://www.cnnindonesia.com/nasional/20250221220253-20-1201186/ricuh-aksi-indonesia-gelap-di-makassar-polisi-amankan-6-orang|title=Ricuh Aksi 'Indonesia Gelap' di Makassar, Polisi Amankan 6 Orang|website=cnnindonesia.com|access-date=21 February 2025}} although they were later sent home by 04:00 [[Time in Indonesia|WITA]]{{cite web|url=https://makassar.tribunnews.com/2025/02/22/polrestabes-makassar-pulangkan-6-terduga-pelaku-tawuran-demo-indonesia-gelap-jelang-subuh|title=Polrestabes Makassar Pulangkan 6 Terduga Pelaku Tawuran Demo 'Indonesia Gelap' Jelang Subuh|website=makassar.tribunnews.com|access-date=22 February 2025}} On 24 February, protesters from 16 organisations, including student elements, arrived below the flyover of Urip Sumoharjo Road at 14:45 [[Time in Indonesia|WITA]] They also wore ropes on their left hands and prepared other attributes, including banners and a loudspeaker.{{cite web|url=https://www.detik.com/sulsel/makassar/d-7792837/demo-indonesia-gelap-di-makassar-hari-ini-mahasiswa-mulai-datangi-flyover|title=Demo Indonesia Gelap di Makassar Hari Ini, Mahasiswa Mulai Datangi Flyover|website=detik.com|access-date=24 February 2025}} Protests started at 3:35 [[Time in Indonesia|WITA]], and used tires were burned during the event. They began to disperse at 17:00 WITA.{{cite web|url=https://www.detik.com/sulsel/makassar/d-7793402/massa-demo-indonesia-gelap-di-flyover-makassar-bubar-lalin-mulai-lancar|title=Massa Demo 'Indonesia Gelap' di Flyover Makassar Bubar, Lalin Mulai Lancar|website=detik.com|access-date=26 February 2025}} On 19 March, protesters under Muslim Students' Association (HMI) protested front of South Sulawesi DPRD at Urip Sumoharjo Road. They additionally burned used tires and gave a speech at middle of the road. The protesters finally began to disperse on 17:41 WITA after being accepted by parliament members.{{cite web|url=https://www.detik.com/sulsel/makassar/d-7831542/mahasiswa-demo-tolak-revisi-uu-tni-di-dprd-sulsel-bubar-lalin-kembali-lancar|title=Mahasiswa Demo Tolak Revisi UU TNI di DPRD Sulsel Bubar, Lalin Kembali Lancar|website=detik.com|access-date=19 March 2025}} On 5 August, students from the State University of Makassar held a protest under a flyover road at AP Pettarani Road. They were seen flying Jolly Roger flags (see [[#Background]]) and carrying posters containing their demands, deeming that the proposed revisions to the {{ill|Criminal Procedure Law of Indonesia|id|Kitab Undang-Undang Hukum Acara Pidana Indonesia}} (KUHAP) are not transparent and involve little public participation.{{cite web|url=https://www.suara.com/news/2025/08/05/185803/mahasiswa-unm-makassar-demo-kibarkan-bendera-one-piece|title=Mahasiswa UNM Makassar Demo, Kibarkan Bendera One Piece|website=suara.com|access-date=2025-08-06}} One motorcycle driver was forced to get off his motorcycle and almost being assaulted by protesters after attempting to infiltrate them. Another protest occurred at South Sulawesi DPRD building, and they finally dispersed on 16:30 WITA.{{cite web|url=https://www.detik.com/sulsel/makassar/d-8046408/pemotor-di-makassar-nyaris-diamuk-massa-gegara-terobos-demo-tutup-jalan|title=Pemotor di Makassar Nyaris Diamuk Massa Gegara Terobos Demo Tutup Jalan|website=detik.com|access-date=2025-08-06}} On 25 August, several alliances, including Makassar Democratic People's Federation and Contesting People's Union, as well as students from the Students' Union of State University of Makassar (UNM) and the Faculty of Law at the Islamic University of Indonesia, held protests at various places in Makassar. Among the locations include the buildings and headquarters of Makassar DPRD, South Sulawesi DPRD, Bank Sulselbar, Pertamina, RS Cahaya Medika, and the Alauddin-Pettarani Junction. They highlighted several corruption cases, which involved the construction project of a library in [[Pangkajene Islands Regency|Pangkajene Islands]], the main ideas of [[Bone Regency]] funds, and the corporate social responsibility funds from [[Bank Indonesia]] (BI) and [[Financial Services Authority (Indonesia)|Financial Services Authority]] (OJK){{cite web|url=https://sulsel.suara.com/read/2025/08/25/084917/15-titik-demo-di-makassar-hari-ini-tuntut-ganti-presiden-korupsi-csr-bi-hingga-lingkungan|title=15 Titik Demo di Makassar Hari Ini: Tuntut Ganti Presiden, Korupsi CSR BI, Hingga Lingkungan|website=sulsel.suara.com|access-date=2025-08-25}} ==== Other cities in Sulawesi ==== In [[Palopo]], non-governmental organisation Aspirasi held a protest front of Palopo mayor office on 29 March in support of Armed Forces Law.{{cite web|url=https://palopopos.fajar.co.id/2025/03/29/warga-palopo-demo-dukung-revisi-uu-tni/|title=Warga Palopo Demo Dukung Revisi UU TNI|website=palopopos.fajar.co.id|date=29 March 2025 |access-date=2025-03-30}} In [[Kendari]], students from [[Haluoleo University]] protested front of the building of Southeast Sulawesi DPRD, and 100 joint personnels were deployed to guard the protests. They rejected budget cuts in various sectors.{{cite web|url=https://langitsultra.com/2025/02/19/demo-di-dprd-sultra-mahasiswa-di-kendari-tolak-efisiensi-anggaran-di-sektor-pendidikan/|title=Demo di DPRD Sultra, Mahasiswa di Kendari Tolak Efisiensi Anggaran di Sektor Pendidikan|website=langitsultra.com|date=19 February 2025 |access-date=19 February 2025}} [[File:PasslawStartwar.jpg|thumb|A still image of a student successfully overpowering a policeman in a duel atop a police truck in [[North Sulawesi]] became a rallying cry for continued protest, 20 March.{{Cite web |date=2025-03-21 |title=Duel Sengit Mahasiswa Vs Polisi di Atas Truk saat Demo di Depan DPRD Sulut |url=https://www.tvonenews.com/berita/nasional/313554-duel-sengit-mahasiswa-vs-polisi-di-atas-truk-saat-demo-di-depan-dprd-sulut |access-date=2025-04-22 |website=www.tvonenews.com |language=id}}{{cite web |title=Duel Sengit Mahasiswa-Polisi Adu Jotos di Atas Truk Saat Demo Depan DPRD Sulut |url=https://www.beritasatu.com/network/wartabanjar/499269/duel-sengit-mahasiswa-polisi-adu-jotos-di-atas-truk-saat-demo-depan-dprd-sulut |access-date=23 April 2025 |website=BeritaSatu}}]] In [[Manado]], the student protesters under North Sulawesi Movement Alliance organised a [[sit-in]]. They blocked the 17 Agustus Road, precisely front of {{ill|Samsat (Indonesia)|lt=Samsat|id|SamSistem administrasi manunggal satu atap}} Office, effectively causing traffic jams. Hundreds of personnels were deployed by local police at the North Sulawesi Governor's Office, then the protesters attempted to break the entrance gate, tearing apart several pieces of iron. They also burned a bier and used tires.{{cite web|url=https://manado.tribunnews.com/2025/02/19/pendemo-indonesia-gelap-blokade-jalan-17-agustus-polisi-siaga-di-kantor-gubernur-sulawesi-utara|title=Pendemo Indonesia Gelap Blokade Jalan 17 Agustus, Polisi Siaga di Kantor Gubernur Sulawesi Utara|website=manado.tribunnews.com|access-date=19 February 2025}} After waiting for three hours, they were finally permitted to enter the governor's office by Head of National and Political Unity Body of North Sulawesi, Johny Suak.{{cite web|url=https://sulsel.idntimes.com/news/indonesia/savi/demo-indonesia-gelap-di-manado-massa-bakar-ban-dan-keranda?page=all&_gl=1*n5ylb7*_ga*QXV6NDl1S3Y2MkNfLTE4RVROUUx1QnVGTzNtYWxCYkR0eEZvNTlZejZlcmJTZDZfclk5VGUxNmJxbERLNXNBbg..*_ga_TT180KERFB*MTczOTk3MjA2MC4xLjAuMTczOTk3MjA2MS4wLjAuMA..|title=Demo Indonesia Gelap di Manado, Massa Bakar Ban dan Keranda|website=sulsel.idntimes.com|date=19 February 2025 |access-date=19 February 2025}} Later on 20 March, students under North Sulawesi Forward Alliance protested at North Sulawesi DPRD building. After being unable to meet parliament members, they infiltrated barricades installed by the police and clashed with them, causing damage within the building. Clashes between protesters and policemen began at 05:30 p.m., and three protesters were arrested during the event.{{cite web|url=https://sulsel.idntimes.com/news/indonesia/savi-243/tolak-uu-tni-di-manado-demonstran-ditangkap-dan-dipukuli?page=all&_gl=1*1vggzcb*_ga*QXV6NDl1S3Y2MkNfLTE4RVROUUx1QnVGTzNtYWxCYkR0eEZvNTlZejZlcmJTZDZfclk5VGUxNmJxbERLNXNBbg..*_ga_TT180KERFB*MTc0MjUzNDI5Ny4zLjEuMTc0MjUzNDI5Ny4wLjAuMA..|title=Tolak UU TNI di Manado, Demonstran Ditangkap dan Dipukuli|website=idntimes.com|date=20 March 2025 |access-date=21 March 2025}} In [[Palu]], hundreds of students gathered in front of the Central Sulawesi DPRD, mainly from [[Tadulako University]]. The protest almost turned violent with students trying to get through the building gate.{{Cite web |title=Unjukrasa di Depan Kantor DPRD, Mahasiswa Kawal 8 Tuntutan ke Pemerintah |url=https://palu.tribunnews.com/2025/02/21/unjukrasa-di-depan-kantor-dprd-mahasiswa-kawal-8-tuntutan-ke-pemerintah |access-date=21 February 2025 |website=Tribunpalu.com |language=id-ID}} One student was injured in the head as the result of the commotion.{{Cite web |author=Riki |date=21 February 2025 |title=Aksi Indonesia Gelap di Palu Satu Mahasiswa Kepala Luka Bocor |url=https://kailipost.com/2025/02/aksi-indonesia-gelap-di-palu-satu-mahasiswa-kepala-luka-bocor.html |access-date=21 February 2025 |website=Kailipost |language=id}} In [[Mamuju (city)|Mamuju]], [[West Sulawesi]], protests also occurred in Simpang Lima road held by dozens of students who demanded the free nutritious meal program to be evaluated.{{Cite web |date=20 February 2025 |title=Turun Jalan, Mahasiswa di Sulbar Tuntut Makan Gratis di Evaluasi |url=https://mekora.id/turun-jalan-mahasiswa-di-sulbar-tuntut-makan-gratis-di-evaluasi/ |access-date=21 February 2025 |website=Mekora.id |language=id}} In [[Bone Regency|Bone]], a demonstration rejecting the increase in the Rural and Urban Land and Building Tax (PBB-P2) rates ended in chaos. The demonstration prompted the Bone Regency Government to temporarily decide to postpone the 65% increase in PBB-P2 rates. The demonstration, escorted by 1,000 joint Indonesian army and police personnel, took place at the Bone Regent's office on 19 August. The demonstration, organized by the Bone People's Alliance (''Aliansi Rakyat Bone''), initially proceeded peacefully during the day. However, it then turned anarchic, the demonstrators threw firecrackers and molotov cocktails, which were responded to by security officers by throwing tear gas, while carrying out sweeps and forced dispersal.{{cite web|url=https://www.detik.com/sulsel/watampone/d-8071349/akhir-demo-ricuh-di-kantor-bupati-bone-berujung-kenaikan-pbb-ditunda|title=Akhir Demo Ricuh di Kantor Bupati Bone Berujung Kenaikan PBB Ditunda|website=www.detik.com|publisher=Detik|language=id|access-date=28 August 2025|date=21 August 2025}}{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/indonesia/articles/c78zxzn2v4vo|title='Pemerintah pusat lepas tanggung jawab, pemda terjepit' – Mengapa gerakan warga disebut satu-satunya cara batalkan kenaikan pajak?|publisher=BBC Indonesia|language=id|access-date=28 August 2025|date=19 August 2025|first=Darul|last=Amri}} === Maluku Islands === {| class="infobox selfreference" style="width:22em;" |All dates are in [[Eastern Indonesia Time]] (WIT; [[UTC+09:00]]). |} In [[Ambon, Maluku|Ambon]], students from the State Islamic Institute of Ambon (IAIN Ambon), with their almamaters, protested in front of the Maluku DPRD building.{{cite web|url=https://titastory.id/demo-indonesia-gelap-ratusan-mahasiswa-iain-ambon-turun-ke-jalan/|title=Demo Indonesia Gelap Ratusan Mahasiswa IAIN Ambon Turun ke Jalan|website=titastory.id|date=20 February 2025 |access-date=20 February 2025}} The students rejected the free meal program and demanded the Presidential Instruction Number 1 of 2025 repealed while stating what Indonesia needs is free education.{{Cite web |title=Mahasiswa di Ambon Demo #IndonesiaGelap, Tolak MBG |url=https://kumparan.com/kumparannews/mahasiswa-di-ambon-demo-indonesiagelap-tolak-mbg-24XLQqSYdXg |access-date=20 February 2025 |website=kumparan |language=id-ID}}{{Cite web |date=20 February 2025 |title=Mahasiswa Di Ambon Demo Tolak Inpres Nomor 1 Tahun 2025 |website=Potretmaluku.id |url=https://potretmaluku.id/mahasiswa-di-ambon-demo-tolak-inpres-nomor-1-tahun-2025/ |access-date=20 February 2025 |language=id}} In [[Ternate]], hundreds of students gathered in front off the Ternate mayor office building and protested the free meal program by the government. The students laid out several demands such as free education, to repeal the Presidential Instruction Number 1 of 2025, allowances for teachers and university lecturers, as well as local issues such as demanding 50% reserved employment quota for women in the city government, rejecting land reclamation program in the city, and concern about the city's piped water infrastructure.{{Cite web |work=cermat |date=24 February 2025 |title=Apa Saja Tuntutan Mahasiswa saat Demo #IndonesiaGelap di Ternate? |url=https://www.cermat.co.id/apa-saja-tuntutan-mahasiswa-saat-demo-indonesiagelap-di-ternate/ |access-date=28 February 2025 |language=id}} The protest later turned violent with two journalists reportedly assaulted by the city's [[Municipal Police (Indonesia)|Municipal Police]].{{Cite web |last=Lamaau |first=Nurkholis |date=24 February 2025 |title=2 Jurnalis di Ternate Diduga Dianiaya Oknum Satpol PP Saat Liput Demo |url=https://news.detik.com/berita/d-7793298/2-jurnalis-di-ternate-diduga-dianiaya-oknum-satpol-pp-saat-liput-demo |access-date=28 February 2025 |website=detiknews |language=id-ID}} The next day on 25 February 2025, journalists and media workers in the city held a separate demonstration condemning the assault. [[Alliance of Independent Journalists]] and Indonesian Union of Journalist's North Maluku chapter also condemned the incident as against freedom of press and a breach of laws.{{Cite web |date=26 February 2025 |title=Demo 'Indonesia Gelap' berlangsung di Makassar dan kota lainnya – Apa reaksi Prabowo? |url=https://www.bbc.com/indonesia/articles/ckg8n1xn3jgo |access-date=28 February 2025 |website=BBC News Indonesia |language=id}} In [[Morotai Island Regency|Morotai Island]], protest was held predominantly by Pasifik University (UNIPAS) in front off the regent's office and parliament building (DPRD). The students brought a banner written "''Republik oligarki, Indonesia gelap, Malut butuh pendidikan gratis''" (Oligarchic republic, dark Indonesia, North Maluku needs free education). The students criticized the free meal programs is ineffective and what Indonesian students need is free education.{{Cite web |work=Fajar Malut |date=25 February 2025 |title=Demo "Indonesia Gelap" di Morotai, Mahasiswa Kepung Kantor Bupati dan DPRD |url=https://fajarmalut.com/2025/02/26/demo-indonesia-gelap-di-morotai-mahasiswa-kepung-kantor-bupati-dan-dprd/ |access-date=28 February 2025 |language=id}} === Papua === {| class="infobox selfreference" style="width:22em;" |All dates are in Eastern Indonesia Time (WIT; [[UTC+09:00]]). |} In [[Manokwari]], on 10 April, students' union of the [[University of Papua]] (UNIPA) held demonstrations at three separate places: the UNIPA campus, Mansinam hostel, and Makalo stop signal. The participants were guarded by Manokwari regional police, and they also carried several banners, such as {{lang|id|UU TNI mempercepat genosida dan ekosida di Papua}} ('Armed Forces Law hastens genocide and ecocide in Papua'). During the event, two protesters were arrested by the police. The crowd negotiated with West Papua DPRD, {{ill|West Papua People's Council|id|Majelis Rakyat Papua Barat}}, and the police.{{cite web|url=https://jagatpapua.com/bem-unipa-aksi-demo-desak-presiden-ri-cabut-uu-tni-dan-tolak-psn-di-seluruh-tanah-papua/|title=BEM UNIPA Aksi Demo Desak Presiden RI Cabut UU TNI dan Tolak PSN di Seluruh Tanah Papua|website=jagatpapua.com|date=10 April 2025 |access-date=2025-04-10}} In [[Wamena]], thousands of students held a demonstration as a form of rejection of the government's free nutritious meal program on Monday, 17 February 2025. The students rejected the program, stating that what they need is instead free education and improvement on facilities. It is estimated that around 3,500 students participated, consisting of middle school, high school and university students. Thousands of students came from [[Wamena]], [[Jayawijaya Regency]] and [[Yahukimo Regency]], based on the police information.{{Cite web |date=18 February 2025 |title=Alasan Pelajar di Papua Pegunungan Tolak Makan Bergizi Gratis |url=https://www.tempo.co/politik/alasan-pelajar-di-papua-pegunungan-tolak-makan-bergizi-gratis-1208620 |access-date=21 February 2025 |website=Tempo |language=id}} A riot occurred at around 09.00 [[Eastern Indonesia Time|WIT]], when the crowd moved towards the Menara Salib located in front of the Jayawijaya Regent's office and took place on Hom-Hom Road, several hundred meters from the Jayawijaya regent's office.{{Cite web |date=18 February 2025 |title=Fakta-fakta Demo Pelajar Papua Tuntut Pendidikan Gratis Bukan Makanan Gratis |url=https://www.tempo.co/hukum/fakta-fakta-demo-pelajar-papua-tuntut-pendidikan-gratis-bukan-makanan-gratis--1208931 |access-date=21 February 2025 |website=Tempo |language=id}} In [[Paniai Regency|Paniai]], thousands of students from all levels (elementary, middle school, high School and vocational school) held a demonstration against the free nutritious meal (MBG) program on Monday, 24 February 2025. They went to the Paniai Regent's Office in Madi Village, {{ill|East Paniai District|id|Paniai Timur, Paniai}} and asked the government to prioritize free education.{{Cite web |date=24 February 2025 |title=Ratusan Pelajar di Paniai Gelar Aksi Demo Tolak Program Makan Bergizi Gratis |url=https://koranpapua.id/2025/02/24/ratusan-pelajar-di-paniai-gelar-aksi-demo-tolak-program-makan-bergizi-gratis/ |access-date=25 February 2025 |website=Koran Papua |language=id}}{{Cite web |date=24 February 2025 |title=Pelajar Se-Kabupaten Paniai Tolak Makan Gratis, Tuntut Pendidikan Gratis |url=https://www.nabire.net/pelajar-se-kabupaten-paniai-tolak-makan-gratis-tuntut-pendidikan-gratis/ |access-date=25 February 2025 |website=Nabire.Net |language=id}} In [[Deiyai Regency|Deiyai]], a Free Nutritious Meal (MBG) protest was held and attended by thousands of students from dozens of schools. They carried out a long towards the Deiyai regent's office. Wearing elementary, middle and high school uniforms, the students walked from the [[Thomas Adii Football Field]] at around 09.30 [[Eastern Indonesia Time|WIT]] to the regent's office.{{Cite web |date=26 February 2025 |title=MBG: Demo pelajar terus berlanjut di Papua – 'Kami menolak makan bergizi gratis' |url=https://www.bbc.com/indonesia/articles/c5yr76ynp0do |access-date=28 February 2025 |website=BBC News Indonesia |language=id}} In [[Jayapura]], a protest action by students of the [[Cenderawasih University]] was carried out on Wednesday, 26 February 2025. They delivered their aspirations directly to the Papuan [[House of Representatives (Indonesia)|House of Representatives]] regarding the Law on the Indonesian National Army and demanded the repeal of the law.{{Cite web |last=Cepos |first=Juna |date=2025-03-28 |title=Mahasiswa Uncen Akhirnya Ikutan Demo Tolak UU TNI |url=https://cenderawasihpos.jawapos.com/berita-utama/28/03/2025/mahasiswa-uncen-akhirnya-ikutan-demo-tolak-uu-tni/ |access-date=2025-03-29 |website=Cenderawasih Pos |language=id}} On 7 April, students who are members of the central leadership committee of the Independent Forum of West Papua Students (FIM-WP) conducted a demonstration against [[Freeport Indonesia]] at Ekspo Waena and Perumnas III Waena, Heram District. This peaceful protest started from the Cenderawasih University campus and moved towards the Perumnas III taxi round. However, the protest was forcibly dispersed by joint TNI-Polri officers. In [[Nabire]], peaceful demonstration held by protesters who reject [[Freeport Indonesia|PT Freeport Indonesia]]. The protesters organised a long march to the office of the Central Papua Provincial [[House of Representatives (Indonesia)|House of Representatives]]. Unfortunately, the police forbade it because it would disturb public order. The demonstration lasted until it was forcibly dispersed. === Overseas === The earlier overseas protest were organised by group of Indonesian students studying at [[Columbia University]] in [[New York City]] under the name of ''Jong Columbia'' on 21 February from 16:00 [[Time in Indonesia|WIB]] until 18:00 WIB in New Residence Hall, [[Teachers College, Columbia University]] which gathered more than 100 students. At the same time the leaders of Indonesian Students Union in Japan, Malaysia, and The Netherlands published an open letter expressing their solidarity with the student union protesters back home.{{cite web|url=https://www.tempo.co/politik/diaspora-di-berlin-siapkan-demonstrasi-indonesia-gelap-1212657|title=Mahasiswa Indonesia di Luar Negeri Ikut Suarakan Tuntutan Peringatan Darurat Indonesia Gelap|website=liputan6.com|access-date=2 March 2025}} The [[Indonesian diaspora]] in Germany planned solidarity protests at the [[Brandenburg Gate]], [[Berlin]], on 1 March.{{cite web|url=https://www.tempo.co/politik/diaspora-di-berlin-siapkan-demonstrasi-indonesia-gelap-1212657|title=Diaspora di Berlin Siapkan Demonstrasi Indonesia Gelap|website=tempo.co|access-date=27 February 2025}} The Indonesian diaspora in Australia organised solidarity protests at the [[State Library Victoria]], [[Melbourne]], on the same day.{{cite web|url=https://www.tempo.co/politik/diaspora-di-australia-demonstrasi-indonesia-gelap--1213719|title=Diaspora di Australia Demonstrasi Indonesia Gelap|website=tempo.co|access-date=1 March 2025}} Indonesian students in Columbia University would later return to protest against the revision of Armed Forces law in front of Teachers College. After the announced increase in housing allowance followed by the killing of motorcycle taxi (''ojol'') driver Affan Kurniawan, several more protests occurred in multiple countries. In the United States, more than 500 protesters gathered under the name of Amerika Bergerak (previously Jong Columbia) between 4 and 6 September in [[New York City]] and several other cities.{{Cite web |title=Instagram |url=https://www.instagram.com/p/DOR8u4HDq46/ |access-date=2025-09-11 |website=www.instagram.com}} In Germany, protesters gathered in late August and early September in [[Aachen]],{{Cite web |title=Instagram |url=https://www.instagram.com/p/DN8ddK4goLG/?igsh=cndqZHFsY3g4dTBo |access-date=2025-09-04 |website=www.instagram.com}} [[Berlin]],{{Cite web |date=2025-09-02 |title=Diaspora di New York, Berlin, dan Melbourne Gelar Aksi Dukung Demo di Tanah Air |url=https://www.tempo.co/internasional/diaspora-di-new-york-berlin-dan-melbourne-gelar-aksi-dukung-demo-di-tanah-air-2065850 |access-date=2025-09-04 |website=Tempo |language=id}} [[Bonn]],{{Cite web |title=Instagram |url=https://www.instagram.com/p/DOHVc9TjFo3/?igsh=MTBmNHliZGgxNTVqMw== |access-date=2025-09-04 |website=www.instagram.com}} Hannover,{{Cite web |title=Instagram |url=https://www.instagram.com/p/DOGicatCsMh/?igsh=MTNxYzJuZ2R1aWVwMA== |access-date=2025-09-04 |website=www.instagram.com}} and [[Cologne]].{{Cite web |title=Instagram |url=https://www.instagram.com/p/DOIhf3hiqnr/?igsh=MWhud3c0NHdic28ycw== |access-date=2025-09-04 |website=www.instagram.com}}{{better source needed|date=September 2025}} Indonesian diaspora in the Netherlands held a demonstration on 4 September 2025, by marching from [[International Institute of Social Studies|ISS]] at the [[Erasmus University Rotterdam]] to the [[Embassy of Indonesia, The Hague|Indonesian Embassy]] in [[The Hague]]. This action was intended as a form of solidarity for Affan Kurniawan, as well as all victims of state violence.{{Cite web |title=Viral Diaspora RI Ramai-ramai Demo, Bawa Tuntutan Rakyat 17+8 |url=https://www.cnbcindonesia.com/tech/20250903111809-37-663875/viral-diaspora-ri-ramai-ramai-demo-bawa-tuntutan-rakyat-17-8 |access-date=2025-09-05 |website=CNBC Indonesia |language=id}} == Reactions == === Domestic === ==== Protesters ==== [[File:Grafiti at the DPR Walls.jpg|thumb|Graffiti on the DPR walls during the 2025 Indonesian protest mimicking [[My God, Help Me to Survive This Deadly Love|''Fraternal Kiss'']]. Begini Kata Anindya Bakrie |website=viva.co.id|date=19 February 2025 |access-date=19 February 2025}} Former secretary of the [[Ministry of State-Owned Enterprises]], {{ill|Said Didu|id}}, through his Twitter account, was confused why the {{lang|id|#IndonesiaGelap}} protests focused on toppling down Prabowo, not to bring Jokowi to justice, while according to himself, the condition was caused by Jokowi's faults.{{cite web|url=https://fajar.co.id/2025/02/20/demo-mahasiswa-indonesia-gelap-fokus-lawan-prabowo-bukan-adili-jokowi-said-didu-ada-yang-sedang/|title=Demo Mahasiswa Indonesia Gelap Fokus Lawan Prabowo Bukan Adili Jokowi, Said Didu: Ada yang Sedang... |website=fajar.co.id|date=20 February 2025 |access-date=20 February 2025}} Policy observer Gigin Praginanto, through his Twitter account, satirised that the protests' theme should be better changed from {{lang|id|Indonesia Gelap}} to {{lang|id|Indonesia Gelap Banget Nget Nget}} ('Indonesia Is Very, Very, Very Dark').{{cite web|url=https://www.eramuslim.com/berita/nasional/pengamat-tema-demo-sebaiknya-diganti-jadi-indonesia-gelap-banget-nget-nget/|title=Pengamat: Tema Demo Sebaiknya Diganti Jadi Indonesia Gelap Banget Nget Nget|website=eramuslim.com|date=20 February 2025 |access-date=20 February 2025}} Actor [[Jefri Nichol]] said that he regretted for participate in a protest, the last one occurred in 2023, when he wasn't able to memorise any content of the chapters while being asked by a journalist.{{cite web|url=https://www.akurat.co/selebriti/1305822110/jefri-nichol-ogah-ikut-demo-lagi-akui-kapok-kemarin-terakhir|title=Jefri Nichol Ogah Ikut Demo Lagi, Akui Kapok: Kemarin Terakhir!|website=akurat.co|access-date=2025-03-28}} There has been call from some internet users urging people to boycott celebrities and products that are supportive toward the government. [[University of Indonesia]], submitted a judicial review on the revised Armed Forces Law to the [[Constitutional Court of Indonesia]]. They noticed numerous irregularities during its revision, deemed as 'unconstitutional' and 'hurried'.{{cite web|url=https://www.tempo.co/politik/mahasiswa-ui-ajukan-gugatan-formil-uu-tni-ke-mahkamah-konstitusi-1222563|title=Mahasiswa UI Ajukan Gugatan Formil UU TNI ke Mahkamah Konstitusi|website=tempo.co|access-date=21 March 2025}} This move was soon followed by the Civil Society Coalition.{{cite web|url=https://m.tribunnews.com/nasional/2025/03/27/koalisi-masyarakat-sipil-bakal-ajukan-uji-materi-uu-tni-ke-mahkamah-konstitusi|title=Koalisi Masyarakat Sipil Bakal Ajukan Uji Materi UU TNI ke Mahkamah Konstitusi|website=tribunnews.com|access-date=28 March 2025}} As the country situation doesn't show any sign of improvement, many young Indonesians have decided to flee the country to search for a new life as the government keep responding to the protest in bad manners.{{Cite web |last=Rahman |first=Adi Fida |title=Ramai Netizen Suarakan #KaburAjaDulu, Kecewa dengan Indonesia? |trans-title=Many netizens and influencers are voicing #JustGoAway, disappointed with Indonesia? |url=https://inet.detik.com/cyberlife/d-7779355/ramai-netizen-suarakan-kaburajadulu-kecewa-dengan-indonesia? |access-date=2025-02-22 |website=detikinet |language=id}} === Market decline === [[File:Jakarta Stock Exchange Composite Index March 18 2025.jpg|thumb|[[Indonesia Stock Exchange]] Composite Index during closing around 9:37 AM on 18 March 2025]] In March 2025, Indonesia's financial markets faced a severe jolt as the [[Jakarta Composite Index]] (JCI) plunged by over 7% in a single trading session. This sharp [[intraday]] decline—recorded on 18 March—was the steepest since 2011. The plunge triggered an automatic 30-minute trading halt as markets faced a decline of 6.146% during closure at around 9:37 AM,{{Cite web |last=Novalius |first=Feby |date=18 March 2025 |title=IHSG Trading Halt, Perdagangan Saham Dihentikan 30 Menit : Okezone Economy |url=https://economy.okezone.com/read/2025/03/18/278/3123542/ihsg-trading-halt-perdagangan-saham-dihentikan-30-menit |access-date=27 March 2025 |website=Okezone |language=id-ID}} a mechanism designed to stabilize markets at 5% during periods of excessive volatility. After a 30-minute halt, trading resumed but the index continued to decline, reaching a 7.1% drop at one point. The sharp decline in Indonesia's stock market quickly rippled across other sectors, with technology and manufacturing companies posting the biggest losses. Shares of {{ill|DCI Indonesia|id}}, a leading provider of data center infrastructure, plunged around 20 percent, falling to 115,800 [[Indonesian rupiah|rupiah]] (approximately $7). Meanwhile, {{ill|Chandra Asri Pacific|id}}, a major player in energy and chemicals, saw its stock price drop nearly 19 percent by the afternoon.{{Cite web |date=18 March 2025 |title=Indonesia: Stock market plunges 7 percent, trading suspended |url=https://www.agenzianova.com/en/news/Indonesia-Stock-Market-Drops-7-Percent-Trading-Suspended/?utm_source=chatgpt.com |access-date=27 March 2025 |website=Agenzia Nova |language=en}} During trading, foreign investors made a net sell of IDR 2.48 trillion, continuing the trend of outflows totalling IDR 29.41 trillion since the beginning of the year. Foreign ownership in the JCI also fell to 2.9%, the lowest since 2011, reflecting a decline in global interest in the Indonesian market. This contrasted with other Asian bourses that rallied.{{cite news |last=Nasition |first=Edy Irawan |date=22 March 2025 |title=Indonesia Gelap! IHSG Ambles dan Trading Halt Diberlakukan Lagi |url=https://emitennews.com/news/indonesia-gelap-ihsg-ambles-dan-trading-halt-diberlakukan-lagi |access-date=5 April 2025 |work=EmitenNews}} The negative market sentiment was fuelled by concerns over national economic conditions. The sudden downturn reflected a deepening crisis of investor confidence, rooted not only in macroeconomic uncertainties but also in political anxieties and shifting fiscal policies under President Prabowo Subianto's administration.{{Cite news |last1=Mariska |first1=Diana |last2=Lakshmi |first2=A. Anantha |date=18 March 2025 |title=Indonesian stocks tumble 4% on concerns over economy |url=https://www.ft.com/content/aae80518-0e3b-4d79-a2a3-339dfa162478?utm_source=chatgpt.com |access-date=27 March 2025 |work=Financial Times}} In February alone, the state budget (APBN) recorded a deficit of IDR 31.2 trillion, while the [[consumer confidence index]] and [[Average propensity to save|savings ratio]] fell, indicating weak purchasing power. Layoffs increased, with major factories such as [[Yamaha Motor Company|Yamaha]] and PT {{ill|Sanken Indonesia|id}} closing. Tax revenue also weakened, with Income Tax 21 falling 39.5% YoY and IPR declining by 0.5% signalling consumption pressure. There was also a general decline in credit disbursement in Q3 2025 across many provinces, with the slowest growth being SME loans and consumer loans.{{Cite web |last=Mediatama |first=Grahanusa |date=2025-08-28 |title=Penyaluran Kredit Konsumsi di Perbankan Makin Loyo |url=https://keuangan.kontan.co.id/news/penyaluran-kredit-konsumsi-di-perbankan-makin-loyo |access-date=2025-09-01 |website=kontan.co.id |language=id}}{{Cite web |author=Agustinus Yoga Primantoro |date=2025-06-12 |title=Kualitas Memburuk, Penyaluran Kredit UMKM Melambat |url=https://www.kompas.id/artikel/kualitas-memburuk-penyaluran-kredit-umkm-melambat |access-date=2025-09-01 |website=Kompas.id |language=id}} This was attributed to lower consumer purchasing power and confidence as well as unstable political landscape.{{Cite web |author=Agustinus Yoga Primantoro |date=2025-07-12 |title=Pertumbuhan Kredit Terpukul Pelemahan Daya Beli |url=https://www.kompas.id/artikel/pertumbuhan-kredit-terpukul-pelemahan-daya-beli |access-date=2025-09-01 |website=Kompas.id |language=id}} During this period, banks began shifting to corporate and commercial loans to avoid the increased risk in consumer and SME loans, where NPLs have experienced the highest increase. This trend occurred despite existing incentives from the Central Bank, such as lowered interest rates, reflecting the [[credit rationing]] phenomenon observed during the early days of the reformation era.{{Cite journal |last=Azis |first=Iwan J. |date=2019 |title=Macroeconomics Post-GFC |url=https://jurnal.isei.or.id/index.php/isei/article/view/14/5 |journal=Jurnal Ekonomi Indonesia |volume=8 |issue=1 |pages=103–124 |doi=10.52813/jei.v8i1.14 }} Systemic risk looms over the capital market, given the potential impact on the financial sector. Although [[Macroeconomics|macroeconomic]] factors and controversial [[Fiscal policy|fiscal policies]] of the Prabowo Subianto administration were the main culprits, public discourse and political debates also highlighted the revision of the TNI Law (RUU TNI) as a factor that worsened market sentiment.{{Cite web |last=Hadi |first=Aditya |date=18 March 2025 |title=Indonesia's stock market plunges while others shine – Markets |url=https://www.thejakartapost.com/business/2025/03/18/indonesias-stock-market-plunges-while-others-shine.html |access-date=27 March 2025 |website=The Jakarta Post |language=en}} According to a [[Tempo (Indonesian magazine)|Tempo]] report, economist from CELIOS, Nailul Huda, stated that the decline in the JCI has been occurring since 14 March, and the TNI bill is one of the triggers. He highlighted concerns that the military's expanded role in the civilian and economic spheres could lead to legal uncertainty, erode [[meritocracy]], and cause investor fear. One example is the appointment of an active military officer as President Director of [[Perum Bulog]], which fuelled perceptions of military intervention in the business sector.{{Cite web |date=18 March 2025 |title=IHSG Anjlok, Ada Dampak dari RUU TNI? |url=https://www.tempo.co/ekonomi/ihsg-anjlok-ada-dampak-dari-ruu-tni--1221130 |access-date=27 March 2025 |website=Tempo |language=id}}{{Cite news |last=Scholastica |first=Clara Anna |date=20 March 2025 |title=Celios: IHSG dan Rupiah Kompak Terjun Bebas Gara-gara Pengesahan RUU TNI |url=https://www.inilah.com/celios-ihsg-dan-rupiah-kompak-terjun-bebas-gara-gara-pengesahan-ruu-tni |access-date=29 March 2025 |work=Inilah}} Deputy Chairman of Commission I of the House of Representatives [[Budi Djiwandono]] immediately reassured and denied that the TNI Bill was the direct cause of the JCI crash, asserting that there are no articles in the revised draft that explicitly regulate the placement of active TNI officers in state-owned enterprises.{{Cite news |last=Shafira |first=Monique Handa |date=19 March 2025 |title=DPR Bantah RUU TNI Bikin IHSG Anjlok Parah |url=https://www.beritasatu.com/ekonomi/2878220/dpr-bantah-ruu-tni-bikin-ihsg-anjlok-parah |access-date=29 March 2025 |work=Beritasatu}} On the other hand, economists such as [[Wijayanto Samirin]] cited the revision of the TNI Law as one of the five factors that caused the market crash, citing public concerns over the potential return of ABRI's dual function. This view reflects the market's sensitivity to the issue of militarisation, even if only as a perception.{{Cite news |title=DPR Bantah RUU TNI Jadi Sentimen IHSG Anjlok |url=https://www.cnnindonesia.com/ekonomi/20250319121149-92-1210610/dpr-bantah-ruu-tni-jadi-sentimen-ihsg-anjlok |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250322001448/https://www.cnnindonesia.com/ekonomi/20250319121149-92-1210610/dpr-bantah-ruu-tni-jadi-sentimen-ihsg-anjlok? |archive-date=22 March 2025 |access-date=27 March 2025 |work=CNN Indonesia |language=id-ID |url-status=live }} The response from Indonesian authorities was swift but indicative of broader systemic stress. The [[Financial Services Authority (Indonesia)|Financial Services Authority]] (OJK) introduced temporary measures allowing publicly listed firms to buy back shares without requiring prior shareholder approval—a move aimed at supporting valuations and signaling confidence. Concurrently, [[Bank Indonesia]] intervened in the foreign exchange market to stabilize the rupiah, deploying a combination of rate tools and reserves. These interventions did moderate the pace of capital outflows but did little to resolve the underlying concerns surrounding fiscal direction and political stability.{{Cite news |last1=Sulaiman |first1=Stefanno |last2=Suroyo |first2=Gayatri |date=19 March 2025 |title=Indonesia takes currency, market measures after rupiah and shares fall |url=https://www.reuters.com/markets/asia/indonesia-takes-currency-stock-market-measures-after-rupiah-index-fall-2025-03-19/?utm_source=chatgpt.com |access-date=29 March 2025 |work=Reuters}} By August, the JCI had recovered and broken its previous all-time record.{{cite news |title=IHSG Kembali Melemah Sore Ini, Kian Menjauh dari 8.000 |url=https://www.cnnindonesia.com/ekonomi/20250819162607-92-1264104/ihsg-kembali-melemah-sore-ini-kian-menjauh-dari-8000 |access-date=19 August 2025 |work=CNN Indonesia |date=19 August 2025 |language=id}} After the 25–28 August protest turned violent, the Rupiah weakened 0.86% to the U.S. Dollar with a value of IDR 16,455 per U.S. Dollar the following Friday morning.[https://www.cnbcindonesia.com/market/20250829100853-17-662442/breaking-rupiah-makin-anjlok-ke-rp-16455--us- Breaking! Rupiah Makin Anjlok ke Rp 16.455/ US$] The incident also caused another Indonesian stock market crash with the IDX Composite experiencing a 2% decline in the Friday morning market session, due to a high amount of panic selling among foreign investors.[https://katadata.co.id/finansial/bursa/68b11e7da0804/ihsg-merosot-2-imbas-aksi-demo-saham-bank-besar-bbca-bbri-hingga-bbni-rontok IHSG Merosot 2% Imbas Aksi Demo, Saham Bank Besar BBCA, BBRI hingga BBNI Rontok] == Investigation == On 17 June 2025, the [[Attorney General's Office of Indonesia]] (Kejagung) revealed during a press conference, a video of Marcella Santoso confessing that she had created numerous negative content surrounding Armed Forces Law, including {{lang|id|#IndonesiaGelap}} protests and a petition calling for its repeal. A day later, she quickly denied her own confession after being interrogated by Kejagung. Marcella herself is an advocate who previously involved in acquittal during a crude palm oil (CPO) corruption scandal, money laundering, and [[offences against public justice|obstruction of justice]], the latter of which also involving fellow advocate Junaedi Saibih and the news director of [[Jak TV]], Tian Bahtiar. Director of investigation at Kejagung, Abdul Qohar admitted that the investigators from Solicitor General for Special Crimes (Jampidsus) have not yet entered that issue.{{cite web|last1=Media |first1=Kompas Cyber |url=https://nasional.kompas.com/read/2025/06/18/18483041/marcella-santoso-kemarin-ngaku-bikin-konten-indonesia-gelap-kini-membantah?page=all|title=Marcella Santoso Kemarin Ngaku Bikin Konten Indonesia Gelap, Kini Membantah|website=nasional.kompas.com|date=18 June 2025 |access-date=2025-06-25}} Head of Information Centre at TNI, Major General [[Kristomei Sianturi]] found a number of proofs regarding the funds by Marcella flowing into [[buzzer (internet)|buzzers]], [[non-governmental organisation]]s (NGOs), and other foundations, amounting up IDR 500 million and US$2 million, while also investigating its actors and their motives.{{cite web|url=https://www.tempo.co/hukum/tni-menduga-marcella-santoso-mendanai-buzzer-dan-lsm-untuk-membuat-konten-negatif-ruu-tni--1774114|title=TNI Menduga Marcella Santoso Mendanai Buzzer dan LSM Untuk Membuat Konten Negatif RUU TNI|website=tempo.co|access-date=2025-06-25}} Executive Director at Amnesty International Indonesia, {{ill|Usman Hamid|id}} criticised that the video reveal has no relevance with the ongoing investigation process involving her, while also alleging "attempts to intimidate students' and civilian movements".{{cite web|url=https://www.tempo.co/politik/video-pengakuan-marcella-santoso-1801705|title=Kenapa Pemutaran Video Marcella Santoso Menuai Kritik|website=tempo.co|access-date=2025-06-25}} == See also == * extract:
Since February 2025, public and student-led anti-government demonstrations have been held throughout several cities in Indonesia.
The first wave of protests were launched on 17 February 2025 by the All-Indonesian Students' Union (BEM SI), together with individual students' unions. According to the central coordinator of BEM SI, Herianto, the alliance had called for protests all over the country on 17 and 18 February (cancelled at Jakarta), while they would hold the protest centrally at Jakarta on 19 (cancelled) and 20 February. The Civil Society Coalition had also called for civilians to participate in demonstrations on 21 February following Friday prayers. BEM SI projected that around 5,000 students would participate in the protests, and they also threatened further actions if the government does not react positively.
The second wave of protests began in March 2025 following the ratification of the newly revised Indonesian National Armed Forces Law, which increased the number of civilian positions that soldiers are allowed to hold, from 10 to 14. Generally, most of the protests were held in front of the buildings of respective legislatures (national or regional), with its participants usually having worn black clothing, marked by the burning of used tires and clashes with policemen. Protests peaked in February and March 2025, but they began to fade since then.
Starting from Pati Regency, Central Java, a third wave of protests erupted around August 10–13, triggered by a proposed 250% increase in land and building taxes (PBB‑P2). The unrest quickly grew, drawing up to 100,000 protesters, with dozens injured. On 25 August, thousands, including students, workers, and activists, marched to the national parliament building in Jakarta, protesting against exorbitant allowances for lawmakers. After an  online motorcycle taxi (Indonesian: ojek online) driver was run over by security officers with an armoured vehicle, protesters grew angry. It was the first recorded fatality during the six-month-long protest. In retaliation, the demonstrators attacked two security officers who were near the location, leaving them lying on the road covered in blood. After protesters started getting aggressive, the military became involved to protect malls from looting. Protesters torched and looted the House of Representatives members' houses, including that of Ahmad Sahroni.
